If a creature's original body or its astral form drops to 0 hit points, the spell ends for that creature. If the spell ends and the silver cord is intact, the cord pulls the creature's astral form back to its body, ending its state of suspended animation. If you are returned to your body prematurely, your companions remain in their astral forms and must find their own way back to their bodies, usually by dropping to 0 hit points.

spell:foresight-legacy.description: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. For the duration, the target can't be surprised and has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. Additionally, other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target for the duration. This spell immediately ends if you cast it again before its duration ends.

spell:gate-legacy.components: V, S, M (A diamond worth at least 5,000gp.)
spell:gate-legacy.description: You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane of existence. The portal is a circular opening, which you can make 5 to 20 feet in diameter. You can orient the portal in any direction you choose. The portal lasts for the duration. The portal has a front and a back on each plane where it appears. Travel through the portal is possible only by moving through its front. Anything that does so is instantly transported to the other plane, appearing in the unoccupied space nearest to the portal. Deities and other planar rulers can prevent portals created by this spell from opening in their presence or anywhere within their domains. When you cast this spell, you can speak the name of a specific creature (a pseudonym, title, or nickname doesn't work). If that creature is on a plane other than the one you are on, the portal opens in the named creature's immediate vicinity and draws the creature through it to the nearest unoccupied space on your side of the portal. You gain no special power over the creature, and it is free to act as the GM deems appropriate. It might leave, attack you, or help you.

spell:imprisonment-legacy.components: V, S, M (A vellum depiction or a carved statuette in the likeness of the target, and a special component that varies according to the version of the spell you choose, worth at least 500gp per Hit Die of the target.)
spell:imprisonment-legacy.description: You create a magical restraint to hold a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be bound by the spell; if it succeeds, it is immune to this spell if you cast it again. While affected by this spell, the creature doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, and it doesn't age. Divination spells can't locate or perceive the target. When you cast the spell, you choose one of the following forms of imprisonment. ***Burial.*** The target is entombed far beneath the earth in a sphere of magical force that is just large enough to contain the target. Nothing can pass through the sphere, nor can any creature teleport or use planar travel to get into or out of it. The special component for this version of the spell is a small mithral orb. ***Chaining.*** Heavy chains, firmly rooted in the ground, hold the target in place. The target is restrained until the spell ends, and it can't move or be moved by any means until then. The special component for this version of the spell is a fine chain of precious metal. ***Hedged Prison.*** The spell transports the target into a tiny demiplane that is warded against teleportation and planar travel. The demiplane can be a labyrinth, a cage, a tower, or any similar confined structure or area of your choice. The special component for this version of the spell is a miniature representation of the prison made from jade. ***Minimus Containment.*** The target shrinks to a height of 1 inch and is imprisoned inside a gemstone or similar object. Light can pass through the gemstone normally (allowing the target to see out and other creatures to see in), but nothing else can pass through, even by means of teleportation or planar travel. The gemstone can't be cut or broken while the spell remains in effect. The special component for this version of the spell is a large, transparent gemstone, such as a corundum, diamond, or ruby. ***Slumber.*** The target falls asleep and can't be awoken. The special component for this version of the spell consists of rare soporific herbs. ***Ending the Spell.*** During the casting of the spell, in any of its versions, you can specify a condition that will cause the spell to end and release the target. The condition can be as specific or as elaborate as you choose, but the GM must agree that the condition is reasonable and has a likelihood of coming to pass. The conditions can be based on a creature's name, identity, or deity but otherwise must be based on observable actions or qualities and not based on intangibles such as level, class, or hit points. A dispel magic spell can end the spell only if it is cast as a 9th-level spell, targeting either the prison or the special component used to create it. You can use a particular special component to create only one prison at a time. If you cast the spell again using the same component, the target of the first casting is immediately freed from its binding.

spell:mass-heal-legacy.description: A flood of healing energy flows from you into injured creatures around you. You restore up to 700 hit points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range. Creatures healed by this spell are also cured of all diseases and any effect making them blinded or deafened. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

spell:meteor-swarm-legacy.description: Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points you can see within range. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on each point you choose must make a dexterity saving throw. The sphere spreads around corners. A creature takes 20d6 fire damage and 20d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature in the area of more than one fiery burst is affected only once. The spell damages objects in the area and ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried.

spell:power-word-kill-legacy.description: You utter a word of power that can compel one creature you can see within range to die instantly. If the creature you choose has 100 hit points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.

spell:prismatic-wall-legacy.description: A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall--up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick--centered on a point you can see within range. Alternatively, you can shape the wall into a sphere up to 30 feet in diameter centered on a point you choose within range. The wall remains in place for the duration. If you position the wall so that it passes through a space occupied by a creature, the spell fails, and your action and the spell slot are wasted. The wall sheds bright light out to a range of 100 feet and dim light for an additional 100 feet. You and creatures you designate at the time you cast the spell can pass through and remain near the wall without harm. If another creature that can see the wall moves to within 20 feet of it or starts its turn there, the creature must succeed on a constitution saving throw or become blinded for 1 minute. The wall consists of seven layers, each with a different color. When a creature attempts to reach into or pass through the wall, it does so one layer at a time through all the wall's layers. As it passes or reaches through each layer, the creature must make a dexterity saving throw or be affected by that layer's properties as described below. The wall can be destroyed, also one layer at a time, in order from red to violet, by means specific to each layer. Once a layer is destroyed, it remains so for the duration of the spell. A rod of cancellation destroys a prismatic wall, but an antimagic field has no effect on it. ***1. Red.*** The creature takes 10d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. While this layer is in place, nonmagical ranged attacks can't pass through the wall. The layer can be destroyed by dealing at least 25 cold damage to it. ***2. Orange.*** The creature takes 10d6 acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. While this layer is in place, magical ranged attacks can't pass through the wall. The layer is destroyed by a strong wind. ***3. Yellow.*** The creature takes 10d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This layer can be destroyed by dealing at least 60 force damage to it. ***4. Green.*** The creature takes 10d6 poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A passwall spell, or another spell of equal or greater level that can open a portal on a solid surface, destroys this layer. ***5. Blue.*** The creature takes 10d6 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This layer can be destroyed by dealing at least 25 fire damage to it. ***6. Indigo.*** On a failed save, the creature is restrained. It must then make a constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves three times, the spell ends. If it fails its save three times, it permanently turns to stone and is subjected to the petrified condition. The successes and failures don't need to be consecutive; keep track of both until the creature collects three of a kind. While this layer is in place, spells can't be cast through the wall. The layer is destroyed by bright light shed by a daylight spell or a similar spell of equal or higher level. ***7. Violet.*** On a failed save, the creature is blinded. It must then make a wisdom saving throw at the start of your next turn. A successful save ends the blindness. If it fails that save, the creature is transported to another plane of the GM's choosing and is no longer blinded. (Typically, a creature that is on a plane that isn't its home plane is banished home, while other creatures are usually cast into the Astral or Ethereal planes.) This layer is destroyed by a dispel magic spell or a similar spell of equal or higher level that can end spells and magical effects.

spell:shapechange-legacy.components: V, S, M (A jade circlet worth at least 1,500 gp, which you must place on your head before you cast the spell.)
spell:shapechange-legacy.description: You assume the form of a different creature for the duration. The new form can be of any creature with a challenge rating equal to your level or lower. The creature can't be a construct or an undead, and you must have seen the sort of creature at least once. You transform into an average example of that creature, one without any class levels or the Spellcasting trait. Your game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the chosen creature, though you retain your alignment and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You also retain all of your skill and saving throw proficiencies, in addition to gaining those of the creature. If the creature has the same proficiency as you and the bonus listed in its statistics is higher than yours, use the creature's bonus in place of yours. You can't use any legendary actions or lair actions of the new form. You assume the hit points and Hit Dice of the new form. When you revert to your normal form, you return to the number of hit points you had before you transformed. If you revert as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to your normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce your normal form to 0 hit points, you aren't knocked unconscious. You retain the benefit of any features from your class, race, or other source and can use them, provided that your new form is physically capable of doing so. You can't use any special senses you have (for example, darkvision) unless your new form also has that sense. You can only speak if the creature can normally speak. When you transform, you choose whether your equipment falls to the ground, merges into the new form, or is worn by it. Worn equipment functions as normal. The GM determines whether it is practical for the new form to wear a piece of equipment, based on the creature's shape and size. Your equipment doesn't change shape or size to match the new form, and any equipment that the new form can't wear must either fall to the ground or merge into your new form. Equipment that merges has no effect in that state. During this spell's duration, you can use your action to assume a different form following the same restrictions and rules for the original form, with one exception: if your new form has more hit points than your current one, your hit points remain at their current value.

spell:storm-of-vengeance-legacy.description: A churning storm cloud forms, centered on a point you can see and spreading to a radius of 360 feet. Lightning flashes in the area, thunder booms, and strong winds roar. Each creature under the cloud (no more than 5,000 feet beneath the cloud) when it appears must make a constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 thunder damage and becomes deafened for 5 minutes. Each round you maintain concentration on this spell, the storm produces additional effects on your turn. ***Round 2.*** Acidic rain falls from the cloud. Each creature and object under the cloud takes 1d6 acid damage. ***Round 3.*** You call six bolts of lightning from the cloud to strike six creatures or objects of your choice beneath the cloud. A given creature or object can't be struck by more than one bolt. A struck creature must make a dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 10d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. ***Round 4.*** Hailstones rain down from the cloud. Each creature under the cloud takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage. ***Round 5-10.*** Gusts and freezing rain assail the area under the cloud. The area becomes difficult terrain and is heavily obscured. Each creature there takes 1d6 cold damage. Ranged weapon attacks in the area are impossible. The wind and rain count as a severe distraction for the purposes of maintaining concentration on spells. Finally, gusts of strong wind (ranging from 20 to 50 miles per hour) automatically disperse fog, mists, and similar phenomena in the area, whether mundane or magical.

spell:time-stop-legacy.description: You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal. This spell ends if one of the actions you use during this period, or any effects that you create during this period, affects a creature other than you or an object being worn or carried by someone other than you. In addition, the spell ends if you move to a place more than 1,000 feet from the location where you cast it.

spell:true-polymorph-legacy.components: V, S, M (A drop of mercury, a dollop of gum arabic, and a wisp of smoke.)
spell:true-polymorph-legacy.description: Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see within range. You transform the creature into a different creature, the creature into an object, or the object into a creature (the object must be neither worn nor carried by another creature). The transformation lasts for the duration, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. If you concentrate on this spell for the full duration, the transformation becomes permanent. Shapechangers aren't affected by this spell. An unwilling creature can make a wisdom saving throw, and if it succeeds, it isn't affected by this spell. ***Creature into Creature.*** If you turn a creature into another kind of creature, the new form can be any kind you choose whose challenge rating is equal to or less than the target's (or its level, if the target doesn't have a challenge rating). The target's game statistics, including mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of the new form. It retains its alignment and personality. The target assumes the hit points of its new form, and when it reverts to its normal form, the creature returns to the number of hit points it had before it transformed. If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce the creature's normal form to 0 hit points, it isn't knocked unconscious. The creature is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its new form, and it can't speak, cast spells, or take any other action that requires hands or speech unless its new form is capable of such actions. The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment. ***Object into Creature.*** You can turn an object into any kind of creature, as long as the creature's size is no larger than the object's size and the creature's challenge rating is 9 or lower. The creature is friendly to you and your companions. It acts on each of your turns. You decide what action it takes and how it moves. The GM has the creature's statistics and resolves all of its actions and movement. If the spell becomes permanent, you no longer control the creature. It might remain friendly to you, depending on how you have treated it. ***Creature into Object.*** If you turn a creature into an object, it transforms along with whatever it is wearing and carrying into that form. The creature's statistics become those of the object, and the creature has no memory of time spent in this form, after the spell ends and it returns to its normal form.

spell:true-resurrection-legacy.components: V, S, M (A sprinkle of holy water and diamonds worth at least 25,000gp, which the spell consumes.)
spell:true-resurrection-legacy.description: You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than 200 years and that died for any reason except old age. If the creature's soul is free and willing, the creature is restored to life with all its hit points. This spell closes all wounds, neutralizes any poison, cures all diseases, and lifts any curses affecting the creature when it died. The spell replaces damaged or missing organs and limbs. The spell can even provide a new body if the original no longer exists, in which case you must speak the creature's name. The creature then appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 10 feet of you.

spell:weird-legacy.description: Drawing on the deepest fears of a group of creatures, you create illusory creatures in their minds, visible only to them. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range must make a wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes frightened for the duration. The illusion calls on the creature's deepest fears, manifesting its worst nightmares as an implacable threat. At the start of each of the frightened creature's turns, it must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or take 4d10 psychic damage. On a successful save, the spell ends for that creature.

spell:wish-legacy.description: Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal creature can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter the very foundations of reality in accord with your desires. The basic use of this spell is to duplicate any other spell of 8th level or lower. You don't need to meet any requirements in that spell, including costly components. The spell simply takes effect. Alternatively, you can create one of the following effects of your choice: - You create one object of up to 25,000 gp in value that isn't a magic item. The object can be no more than 300 feet in any dimension, and it appears in an unoccupied space you can see on the ground. - You allow up to twenty creatures that you can see to regain all hit points, and you end all effects on them described in the greater restoration spell. - You grant up to ten creatures that you can see resistance to a damage type you choose. - You grant up to ten creatures you can see immunity to a single spell or other magical effect for 8 hours. For instance, you could make yourself and all your companions immune to a lich's life drain attack. - You undo a single recent event by forcing a reroll of any roll made within the last round (including your last turn). Reality reshapes itself to accommodate the new result. For example, a wish spell could undo an opponent's successful save, a foe's critical hit, or a friend's failed save. You can force the reroll to be made with advantage or disadvantage, and you can choose whether to use the reroll or the original roll. You might be able to achieve something beyond the scope of the above examples. State your wish to the GM as precisely as possible. The GM has great latitude in ruling what occurs in such an instance; the greater the wish, the greater the likelihood that something goes wrong. This spell might simply fail, the effect you desire might only be partly achieved, or you might suffer some unforeseen consequence as a result of how you worded the wish. For example, wishing that a villain were dead might propel you forward in time to a period when that villain is no longer alive, effectively removing you from the game. Similarly, wishing for a legendary magic item or artifact might instantly transport you to the presence of the item's current owner. The stress of casting this spell to produce any effect other than duplicating another spell weakens you. After enduring that stress, each time you cast a spell until you finish a long rest, you take 1d10 necrotic damage per level of that spell. This damage can't be reduced or prevented in any way. In addition, your Strength drops to 3, if it isn't 3 or lower already, for 2d4 days. For each of those days that you spend resting and doing nothing more than light activity, your remaining recovery time decreases by 2 days. Finally, there is a 33 percent chance that you are unable to cast wish ever again if you suffer this stress.

spell:blade-ward-legacy.description: Until the end of your next turn you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from weapon attacks.

spell:booming-blade.components: S, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)
spell:booming-blade.description: You channel thunderous energy into a melee weapon and strike a creature. If the target then moves away before your next turn, it takes extra thunder damage.

spell:control-flames.description: You magically manipulate an existing nonmagical flame within range, expanding, extinguishing, or shaping it, or producing simple shapes and colors of fire.

spell:create-bonfire.description: You conjure a magical bonfire in a 5-foot cube. Creatures that enter or start their turn in the fire take fire damage, and it can ignite flammables.

spell:friends-legacy.description: For 1 minute you have advantage on Charisma checks against one non-hostile creature. When it ends, the creature knows you used magic on it and turns hostile.

spell:frostbite.description: You cause numbing frost to form on a creature you can see. It must succeed on a Constitution save or take cold damage and have disadvantage on its next weapon attack roll.

spell:green-flame-blade.components: S, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)
spell:green-flame-blade.description: You brandish a melee weapon and strike a creature, dealing normal damage plus fire. Green fire then leaps to a second nearby creature, dealing fire damage based on your level.

spell:gust.description: You create a brief blast of wind that can push a creature, move a light object, or extinguish unprotected flames.

spell:infestation.description: You cause a cloud of mites, fleas, or other parasites to swarm a creature. It takes poison damage and must move in a random direction on a failed save.

spell:lightning-lure.description: You create a lash of lightning that pulls a creature toward you and deals lightning damage if it fails a Strength save.

spell:magic-stone.description: You touch up to three pebbles and imbue them with magic. You or a companion can make a ranged spell attack with them, dealing bludgeoning damage.

spell:mind-sliver-legacy.description: You drive a disorienting spike of psychic energy into a creature's mind. On a failed Intelligence save it takes psychic damage and subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw.

spell:mold-earth-legacy.description: You manipulate dirt or stone in a 5-foot cube, moving it, shaping it, or creating difficult terrain, or excavating a small amount.

spell:primal-savagery.description: Your teeth or nails sharpen with primal power. You make a melee spell attack that deals acid damage.

spell:shape-water.description: You reshape or animate a 5-foot cube of water, freeze it, change its color or opacity, or create simple shapes that last a short time.

spell:thorn-whip-legacy.components: V, S, M (the stem of a thorny plant)
spell:thorn-whip-legacy.description: You create a long, vine-like whip covered in thorns and make a melee spell attack. On a hit the target takes piercing damage and is pulled closer if it is Large or smaller.

spell:thunderclap-legacy.description: You create a burst of thunderous sound that can be heard from afar. Each creature in a 5-foot radius must succeed on a Constitution save or take thunder damage.

spell:toll-the-dead-legacy.description: You point at a creature and a bell tolls. It takes necrotic damage; more if it is already missing hit points.

spell:word-of-radiance-legacy.description: You utter a divine word and each creature of your choice within 5 feet must succeed on a Constitution save or take radiant damage.

spell:absorb-elements-legacy.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage
spell:absorb-elements-legacy.description: When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you capture some of the energy. You gain resistance to that damage type until your next turn and can add it to a melee attack.

spell:armor-of-agathys-legacy.components: V, S, M (a shard of blue glass)
spell:armor-of-agathys-legacy.description: A protective magical frost covers you, granting temporary hit points. While those points remain, any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes cold damage.

spell:arms-of-hadar-legacy.description: Tendrils of dark energy erupt from you and batter creatures within 10 feet. Each must succeed on a Strength save or take necrotic damage and can't take reactions until its next turn.

spell:beast-bond.components: V, S, M (a bit of fur wrapped in a cloth)
spell:beast-bond.description: You forge a telepathic link with a willing beast. While linked you can communicate with it and it has advantage on attack rolls against creatures within 5 feet of you that you can see.

spell:catapult.description: An unattended object of 1 to 5 pounds flies up to 90 feet in a line. A creature in its path makes a Dexterity save; on a failure the object hits it, and the object and whatever it hits each take 3d8 bludgeoning damage. Higher slots raise the weight limit and damage.

spell:cause-fear.description: You awaken the sense of mortality in a creature. It must succeed on a Wisdom save or become frightened of you; it can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.

spell:ceremony.components: V, S, M (25 gp worth of powdered silver, which the spell consumes)
spell:ceremony.description: You perform a special religious ceremony that can provide various benefits such as atonement, blessing a marriage, or dedicating a creature to a god, depending on the rite chosen.

spell:chromatic-orb-legacy.components: V, S, M (a diamond worth at least 50 gp)
spell:chromatic-orb-legacy.description: Make a ranged spell attack with a 4-inch orb of acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder (your choice): 3d8 damage of that type on a hit, +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

spell:compelled-duel-legacy.description: One creature makes a Wisdom save or, for up to 1 minute, has disadvantage attacking anyone but you and must pass a Wisdom save to move more than 30 feet from you. Ends if you attack or target another hostile, an ally harms it, or you end a turn more than 30 feet away.

spell:dissonant-whispers-legacy.description: You whisper a discordant melody that only one creature can hear. On a failed Wisdom save it takes psychic damage and must use its reaction to move away from you.

spell:earth-tremor-legacy.description: You cause a tremor in the ground within range. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Dexterity save or take bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone; the ground becomes difficult terrain.

spell:ensnaring-strike-legacy.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before the spell ends, thorny vines wrap around it. It takes piercing damage and is restrained on a failed Strength save.

spell:hail-of-thorns-legacy.description: Your next ranged weapon hit before the spell ends (Concentration) bursts into thorns: the target and creatures within 5 feet make a Dexterity save for 1d10 piercing, half on a success (+1d10 per slot level, max 6d10).

spell:ice-knife-legacy.components: S, M (a drop of water or a piece of ice)
spell:ice-knife-legacy.description: You create a shard of ice and fling it at a creature. On a hit it takes piercing damage, then the shard explodes dealing cold damage to the target and nearby creatures on a failed Dexterity save.

spell:ray-of-sickness-legacy.description: A ray of sickening greenish energy streaks toward a creature. On a hit it takes poison damage and must succeed on a Constitution save or be poisoned until the end of your next turn.

spell:searing-smite-legacy.description: Your next melee weapon hit before the spell ends deals an extra 1d6 fire and sets the target alight. At the start of each of its turns it makes a Constitution save: 1d6 fire on a failure, the spell ends on a success. An action to douse the flames also ends it.

spell:silvery-barbs.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself succeeds on an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw
spell:silvery-barbs.description: You magically distract a creature that succeeds on an attack, check, or save, forcing it to reroll and take the lower result. You can then give advantage to another creature's next roll.

spell:snare.components: S, M (25 feet of rope, which the spell consumes)
spell:snare.description: You create a magical trap using a rope. When a creature steps on the trapped area it must succeed on a Dexterity save or be magically hoisted into the air and restrained.

spell:tasha-s-caustic-brew.components: V, S, M (a bit of rotten food)
spell:tasha-s-caustic-brew.description: A stream of acid gushes from you in a line. Each creature in the line must succeed on a Dexterity save or take acid damage at the start of each of its turns until it uses an action to scrape or wash the acid off.

spell:thunderous-smite-legacy.description: Your first melee weapon hit before the spell ends (Concentration) booms audibly to 300 feet and deals an extra 2d6 thunder; a creature makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet and knocked prone.

spell:witch-bolt-legacy.components: V, S, M (a twig struck by lightning)
spell:witch-bolt-legacy.description: Ranged spell attack: 1d12 lightning on a hit, and each turn you can spend your action to deal 1d12 lightning automatically. Ends if you use your action for anything else, or the target leaves range or gains total cover.

spell:wrathful-smite-legacy.description: Your next melee weapon hit before the spell ends deals an extra 1d6 psychic, and a creature makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you. It can use an action on a Wisdom check against your DC to end the spell.

spell:zephyr-strike.description: You move like the wind. Until the spell ends your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, you gain a bonus to speed, and once before it ends you can make one weapon attack with advantage that deals extra force damage.

spell:aganazzar-s-scorcher.components: V, S, M (a red dragon's scale)
spell:aganazzar-s-scorcher.description: A line of roaring flame 30 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must succeed on a Dexterity save or take fire damage.

spell:beast-sense-legacy.description: Touch a willing beast; for the duration you can use your action to see and hear through it (with its special senses), but you are blinded and deafened to your own surroundings until you switch back.

spell:cloud-of-daggers-legacy.components: V, S, M (a sliver of glass)
spell:cloud-of-daggers-legacy.description: A 5-foot cube of spinning daggers: a creature takes 4d4 slashing when it enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there (+2d4 per slot level above 2nd).

spell:cordon-of-arrows-legacy.description: You plant four pieces of nonmagical ammunition in the ground. When a creature other than you comes within 30 feet of them, one flies up and attacks it. The ammunition is destroyed after attacking.

spell:crown-of-madness-legacy.description: You force a humanoid to succumb to madness. On a failed Wisdom save a twisted crown appears on its head and it is charmed by you. You can force it to attack a creature of your choice on its turn.

spell:dragon-s-breath-legacy.description: Touch a willing creature and pick acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. Until the spell ends it can use an action to exhale a 15-foot cone: Dexterity save, 3d6 of that type, half on a success (+1d6 per slot level above 2nd).

spell:earthbind-legacy.description: You attempt to bind a flying creature to the ground. On a failed Strength save its flying speed is reduced to 0 for the duration and it descends safely.

spell:healing-spirit.description: An intangible spirit fills a 5-foot cube. When you or a creature you can see enters its space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, you can heal it 1d6 (no action). It can heal 1 + your spellcasting modifier times; a bonus action moves it 30 feet. No effect on constructs or undead.

spell:maximilian-s-earthen-grasp.components: V, S, M (a miniature hand sculpted from clay)
spell:maximilian-s-earthen-grasp.description: A Medium hand of earth rises in a 5-foot space and grabs a creature within 5 feet of it: Strength save or 2d6 bludgeoning and restrained. As an action you can crush a restrained target (Strength save, 2d6, half on success); breaking free is a Strength check against your DC.

spell:mind-spike-legacy.description: You reach into the mind of a creature you can see. On a failed Wisdom save it takes psychic damage and you know its location until the spell ends, even if it becomes hidden or invisible.

spell:nathair-s-mischief.components: S, M (a piece of crust from an apple pie)
spell:nathair-s-mischief.description: You fill a 20-foot cube with magical effects that randomly cause creatures to laugh uncontrollably, be outlined in faerie fire, or be affected by other mischievous illusions.

spell:phantasmal-force-legacy.components: V, S, M (a bit of fleece)
spell:phantasmal-force-legacy.description: You craft an illusion that takes root in the mind of a creature. On a failed Intelligence save it believes the illusion is real and can take psychic damage from it if the illusion is harmful.

spell:pyrotechnics.description: You cause an area of nonmagical flame to erupt in a dazzling display of fireworks or a thick cloud of smoke that heavily obscures the area.

spell:rime-s-binding-ice.description: A cold wind freezes moisture into ice that covers creatures in a cone. On a failed Constitution save they take cold damage and their speed is reduced to 0 until they or another creature uses an action to break the ice.

spell:shadow-blade.description: You weave together threads of shadow to create a sword of solidified gloom in your hand. It deals psychic damage, has the finesse and light properties, and grants advantage in dim light or darkness.

spell:skywrite.description: You cause up to ten words to appear in a cloud formation in the sky. The words remain for the duration and can be seen from great distances.

spell:snilloc-s-snowball-swarm.components: V, S, M (a piece of ice or a small white rock chip)
spell:snilloc-s-snowball-swarm.description: A flurry of magic snowballs erupts from a point you choose. Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere must succeed on a Dexterity save or take cold damage.

spell:summon-beast-legacy.components: V, S, M (a feather, tuft of fur, and fish tail inside a gilded acorn worth 200+ GP)
spell:summon-beast-legacy.description: You call forth a bestial spirit that takes the form of a land, air, or water beast of your choice. It obeys your commands and acts on your turn.

spell:tasha-s-mind-whip.description: One creature makes an Intelligence save: 3d6 psychic, no reactions until the end of its next turn, and on that turn only one of a move, an action, or a bonus action. Half damage only on a success. One extra target per slot level above 2nd.

spell:warding-wind.description: A strong wind (20 miles per hour) blows around you in a 10-foot radius. It extinguishes unprotected flames, disperses gases, and imposes disadvantage on ranged weapon attacks that pass through it.

spell:warp-sense.description: You gain the ability to sense the presence of portals and planar rifts within range, and can attempt to identify their destinations.

spell:ashardalon-s-stride.description: The billowing flames of a dragon cover your feet, granting you a bonus to speed and allowing you to deal fire damage to creatures you move near without provoking opportunity attacks.

spell:aura-of-vitality-legacy.description: For up to 1 minute a 30-foot aura moves with you; as a bonus action you heal one creature in it (including you) for 2d6.

spell:blinding-smite-legacy.description: Your next melee weapon hit before the spell ends deals an extra 3d8 radiant, and the target makes a Constitution save or is blinded, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

spell:catnap-legacy.description: Up to three willing creatures within 30 feet fall Unconscious for 10 minutes. A target that sleeps undisturbed for the full duration gains a Short Rest's benefits, then can't be affected again until a Long Rest. One extra target per slot level above 3.

spell:conjure-barrage-legacy.components: V, S, M (a Melee or Ranged weapon worth at least 1 CP)
spell:conjure-barrage-legacy.description: Throw a nonmagical weapon or fire a piece of ammunition to make a 60-foot cone of copies: Dexterity save, 3d8 damage of the weapon's type, half on a success.

spell:crusader-s-mantle-legacy.description: Holy power radiates from you in a 30-foot aura. Friendly creatures in the aura deal extra radiant damage with weapon attacks.

spell:elemental-weapon-legacy.description: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls, and it deals extra damage of an elemental type you choose.

spell:enemies-abound.description: One creature makes an Intelligence save (auto-success if immune to fear) or sees every creature as an enemy: it picks targets at random among creatures in range and must take any opportunity attack provoked. It repeats the save each time it takes damage.

spell:erupting-earth.components: V, S, M (a piece of obsidian)
spell:erupting-earth.description: Choose a point on the ground. A fountain of churned earth and stone erupts in a 20-foot cube. Creatures in the area take bludgeoning damage on a failed Dexterity save and the ground becomes difficult terrain.

spell:feign-death-legacy.components: V, S, M (a pinch of graveyard dirt)
spell:feign-death-legacy.description: You touch a willing creature and put it into a cataleptic state that is indistinguishable from death. The target appears dead to all casual inspection and to spells used to determine its status.

spell:flame-arrows.description: You touch a quiver containing arrows or bolts. When a target is hit by a ranged weapon attack using one of those pieces of ammunition, the target takes extra fire damage. The magic ends on a piece of ammunition when it hits or misses.

spell:hunger-of-hadar-legacy.description: You open a gateway to the dark between the stars, a region of cold and darkness that fills a 20-foot radius sphere. Creatures in the area take cold and acid damage and the area is heavily obscured.

spell:intellect-fortress.description: You or one willing creature within range gains resistance to psychic damage and advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves for the duration. One extra target per slot level above 3rd (all within 30 feet of each other).

spell:life-transference.description: You sacrifice some of your own health to mend another creature. You take necrotic damage, and the target regains hit points equal to twice the necrotic damage you take.

spell:lightning-arrow-legacy.castingTime: 1 bonus action, which you can take immediately after hitting or missing a target with a ranged attack using a weapon
spell:lightning-arrow-legacy.description: Your next ranged weapon attack before the spell ends becomes a lightning bolt: 4d8 lightning on a hit (half on a miss) instead of normal damage, and every creature within 10 feet of the target makes a Dexterity save for 2d8, half on a success.

spell:melf-s-minute-meteors.components: V, S, M (niter, sulfur, and pine tar formed into a bead)
spell:melf-s-minute-meteors.description: You create six tiny meteors in your space. As a bonus action you can send one or two streaking toward points you choose, where they explode in a 5-foot radius dealing fire and bludgeoning damage.

spell:spirit-shroud.description: You call forth spirits of the dead that flit around you. Your attacks deal extra necrotic, radiant, or cold damage, and creatures of your choice within 10 feet have their speed reduced.

spell:summon-fey-legacy.components: V, S, M (a gilded flower worth 300+ GP)
spell:summon-fey-legacy.description: You call forth a fey spirit that takes the form of a loyal companion. It has different options for its nature (fuming, mirthful, or tricksy) that grant different abilities.

spell:summon-lesser-demons.components: V, S, M (a vial of blood from a humanoid killed within the past 24 hours)
spell:summon-lesser-demons.description: You summon one or more demons of challenge rating 1 or lower. They appear in unoccupied spaces and act according to their chaotic nature, though you can try to command them.

spell:summon-shadowspawn.components: V, S, M (tears inside a gem worth at least 300 gp)
spell:summon-shadowspawn.description: You call forth a shadowy spirit that takes a form of your choosing (fury, despair, or fear). It obeys your commands and has abilities matching its chosen emotion.

spell:summon-undead-legacy.components: V, S, M (a gilded skull worth 300+ GP)
spell:summon-undead-legacy.description: You call forth an undead spirit that takes the form of a ghostly or putrid undead of your choice. It obeys your verbal commands and acts on your turn.

spell:thunder-step.description: You teleport yourself to an unoccupied space within range. A thunderous boom sounds, and each creature within 10 feet of the space you left must succeed on a Constitution save or take thunder damage.

spell:tidal-wave.components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
spell:tidal-wave.description: You create a wall of water that crashes down on an area. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Dexterity save or take bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone; the water then spreads and extinguishes flames.

spell:tiny-servant.description: You touch an object that is not attached or carried and it animates as a tiny construct under your control. It can perform simple tasks and has limited combat ability.

spell:wall-of-sand.components: V, S, M (a handful of sand)
spell:wall-of-sand.description: A wall of swirling sand up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 10 feet thick. It blocks sight but not movement; a creature inside is blinded and spends 3 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves there.

spell:wall-of-water.components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
spell:wall-of-water.description: A 30-foot-long or 20-foot-ring wall of water, 1 foot thick. Its space is difficult terrain, ranged weapon attacks through it have disadvantage, and fire passing through it deals half damage. Cold damage freezes sections of it solid.

spell:aura-of-life-legacy.description: Life-preserving energy radiates from you in a 30-foot aura. Nonhostile living creatures in the aura have resistance to necrotic damage and their hit point maximum can't be reduced; a creature at 0 hit points that starts its turn there gains 1 hit point.

spell:aura-of-purity-legacy.description: A 30-foot aura moves with you for up to 10 minutes. You and your allies in it have resistance to poison damage and advantage on saves against effects that blind, charm, deafen, frighten, paralyze, poison, or stun (the 2014 version also blocks disease).

spell:charm-monster-legacy.description: You attempt to charm a creature you can see. On a failed Wisdom save it is charmed by you until the spell ends or you or your companions do anything harmful to it.

spell:elemental-bane.description: One creature makes a Constitution save or, for the duration, loses resistance to your chosen damage type (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder) and takes an extra 2d6 of that type the first time each turn it takes such damage. One extra target per slot level above 4th.

spell:find-greater-steed.description: You summon a loyal steed of a more powerful type than the standard Find Steed, such as a griffon or pegasus. It serves you as a mount and companion.

spell:gate-seal.components: V, S, M (a broken portal key, which the spell consumes)
spell:gate-seal.description: A stationary 30-foot cube: portals in it close and can't open, and planar travel into or out of it (Gate, Plane Shift and the like) fails. At 6th level or higher it lasts until dispelled. Consumes a broken portal key.

spell:grasping-vine-legacy.description: A vine sprouts within range. On casting and as a bonus action each turn, it lashes a creature within 30 feet of it: Dexterity save or pulled 20 feet toward the vine.

spell:guardian-of-nature.description: You transform into a powerful guardian form, either a primal beast or a great tree, gaining enhanced senses, attacks, or defensive abilities for the duration.

spell:raulothim-s-psychic-lance.description: You unleash a shimmering lance of psychic energy at a creature you can see or name. On a failed Intelligence save it takes psychic damage and is incapacitated until the start of your next turn.

spell:shadow-of-moil.components: V, S, M (an undead eyeball encased in a gem worth at least 150 gp)
spell:shadow-of-moil.description: Shadows wreathe you until the spell ends: you are heavily obscured, light within 10 feet dims a step, you resist radiant damage, and a creature within 10 feet that hits you with an attack takes 2d8 necrotic.

spell:sickening-radiance.description: Dim green light fills a 30-foot sphere. A creature entering it for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a Constitution save or takes 4d10 radiant, gains a level of exhaustion, and glows so it can't benefit from invisibility. The glow and exhaustion end with the spell.

spell:staggering-smite-legacy.description: Your next melee weapon hit before the spell ends deals an extra 4d6 psychic, and the target makes a Wisdom save or has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks and can't take reactions until the end of its next turn.

spell:storm-sphere.description: A 20-foot sphere of whirling air: creatures in it when it appears or ending a turn there make a Strength save or take 2d6 bludgeoning, and it is difficult terrain. Each turn a bonus action sends a lightning bolt (ranged spell attack, advantage against targets inside) for 4d6 lightning at a creature within 60 feet of its center. +1d6 to each per slot level above 4th.

spell:summon-aberration-legacy.components: V, S, M (a pickled tentacle and an eyeball in a platinum-inlaid vial worth 400+ GP)
spell:summon-aberration-legacy.description: You call forth an aberrant spirit that takes the form of a beholder-like or tentacled creature of your choice. It obeys your commands and has unique abilities based on its form.

spell:summon-construct-legacy.components: V, S, M (a lockbox worth 400+ GP)
spell:summon-construct-legacy.description: You summon a construct spirit that takes a metal or stone form. It follows your verbal commands and can be customized with different defensive or offensive traits.

spell:summon-elemental-legacy.components: V, S, M (air, a pebble, ash, and water inside a gold-inlaid vial worth 400+ GP)
spell:summon-elemental-legacy.description: You call forth an elemental spirit that takes the form of an air, earth, fire, or water elemental of your choice. It obeys your commands and acts on your initiative.

spell:summon-greater-demon.components: V, S, M (a vial of blood from a humanoid killed within the past 24 hours)
spell:summon-greater-demon.description: Summon a demon of CR 5 or lower that rolls its own initiative and follows your verbal commands. At the end of each of its turns it makes a Charisma save (disadvantage if you say its true name); on a success it breaks free and attacks the nearest non-demons. A blood circle can trap it.

spell:vitriolic-sphere-legacy.components: V, S, M (a drop of giant slug bile)
spell:vitriolic-sphere-legacy.description: You point at a location and a 1-foot-diameter glowing green orb of acid streaks there and explodes. Creatures in a 20-foot radius take acid damage on a failed Dexterity save, and residual acid continues to burn on a failed save.

spell:watery-sphere.components: V, S, M (a droplet of water)
spell:watery-sphere.description: You create a sphere of water that can restrain creatures inside it. You can move the sphere and force it to dash, potentially carrying restrained creatures with it or slamming them into surfaces.

spell:banishing-smite-legacy.description: Your next weapon hit before the spell ends deals an extra 5d10 force; if that leaves the target at 50 hit points or fewer it is banished (to its home plane if extraplanar, otherwise to a harmless demiplane, incapacitated) until the spell ends.

spell:circle-of-power-legacy.description: Divine energy radiates from you in a 30-foot aura. Creatures of your choice in the aura have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and resistance to damage from such effects if they succeed.

spell:conjure-volley-legacy.components: V, S, M (a Melee or Ranged weapon worth at least 1 CP)
spell:conjure-volley-legacy.description: Fire a nonmagical piece of ammunition or throw a nonmagical weapon: creatures in a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder make a Dexterity save for 8d8 of the weapon's damage type, half on a success.

spell:control-winds.description: You take control of the air in a 100-foot cube, choosing one of several effects: gusts that push creatures, a downdraft that forces flying creatures to the ground, or an updraft that lifts creatures upward.

spell:danse-macabre.description: Threads of dark power leap from your fingers to pierce up to five Small or Medium corpses. Each becomes an undead skeleton or zombie under your control for the duration.

spell:dawn.components: V, S, M (a sunburst pendant worth at least 100 gp)
spell:dawn.description: A 30-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of sunlight: creatures in it when it appears or ending a turn there make a Constitution save for 4d10 radiant, half on a success. Within 60 feet of it, a bonus action moves it up to 60 feet.

spell:destructive-wave-legacy.description: Chosen creatures within 30 feet of you make a Constitution save: 5d6 thunder plus 5d6 radiant or necrotic (your choice) and knocked prone, or half damage only on a success.

spell:enervation-legacy.description: A creature within 60 feet makes a Dexterity save: 4d8 necrotic on a failure, and each turn you can spend your action to deal 4d8 necrotic automatically; 2d8 and the spell ends on a success. You heal half the necrotic damage dealt. Ends if you use your action otherwise or the target leaves range or gains total cover. +1d8 per slot level above 5th.

spell:far-step.description: You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. On each of your turns before the spell ends you can use a bonus action to teleport in this way again.

spell:holy-weapon.description: You imbue a weapon you touch with holy power. It sheds bright light, deals extra radiant damage on hits, and can burst with radiant energy that blinds nearby enemies when the spell ends.

spell:immolation.description: One creature makes a Dexterity save: 8d6 fire (half on a success). On a failure it keeps burning, shedding light and taking 4d6 fire on each failed save at the end of its turns until it succeeds. Nonmagical means can't douse it, and a creature it kills turns to ash.

spell:infernal-calling.components: V, S, M (a ruby worth at least 999 gp)
spell:infernal-calling.description: You call forth a devil of challenge rating 6 or lower. It appears and may negotiate service; you must offer a suitable payment or risk it acting against your interests.

spell:maelstrom.components: V, S, M (paper or leaf in the shape of a funnel)
spell:maelstrom.description: A swirling mass of water appears in a 30-foot radius. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Strength save or take bludgeoning damage and be pulled toward the center; the area is difficult terrain.

spell:negative-energy-flood-legacy.components: V, M (a broken bone and a square of black silk)
spell:negative-energy-flood-legacy.description: One non-undead creature makes a Constitution save for 5d12 necrotic, half on a success; anything it kills rises next turn as a zombie that attacks the nearest creature it sees. An undead target instead gains half of 5d12 as temporary hit points.

spell:skill-empowerment.description: Your magic deepens a creature's understanding of its own talent. It gains expertise (double proficiency bonus) in one skill of your choice for the duration.

spell:steel-wind-strike-legacy.components: S, M (a Melee weapon worth 1+ SP)
spell:steel-wind-strike-legacy.description: You flourish a weapon and vanish, teleporting to strike up to five creatures you can see within range with a single fluid motion. Make a melee spell attack against each; on a hit the target takes force damage.

spell:summon-celestial-legacy.components: V, S, M (a reliquary worth 500+ GP)
spell:summon-celestial-legacy.description: You call forth a celestial spirit that takes the form of an avenger or defender. It obeys your commands and has healing or radiant abilities based on its form.

spell:summon-draconic-spirit.components: V, S, M (an object with the image of a dragon engraved on it, worth at least 500 gp)
spell:summon-draconic-spirit.description: You summon a draconic spirit that takes the form of a chromatic, gem, or metallic dragon of your choice. It has a breath weapon and other traits matching its type.

spell:swift-quiver-legacy.components: V, S, M (a Quiver worth 1+ GP)
spell:swift-quiver-legacy.description: You transmute your quiver so that it produces an endless supply of nonmagical ammunition. You can make two attacks with a weapon that uses ammunition as a bonus action on each of your turns.

spell:synaptic-static-legacy.description: You choose a point and cause psychic energy to explode there. Creatures in a 20-foot radius must succeed on an Intelligence save or take psychic damage and have their attack rolls, ability checks, and concentration saves penalized for a short time.

spell:transmute-rock.description: You choose an area of stone or mud and transmute it into the other substance. Stone becomes mud (difficult terrain that can restrain) or mud becomes stone (trapping creatures that fail a Dexterity save).

spell:wall-of-light.description: You create a wall of brilliant light that can be shaped as a line or a ring. Creatures that pass through or start their turn in the wall take radiant damage and may be blinded; the wall also sheds bright light.

spell:wrath-of-nature.description: You call on the spirits of nature to animate trees, vines, rocks, and weather in an area, creating multiple hazards that attack or hinder your enemies each turn.

spell:arcane-gate-legacy.description: You create linked teleportation portals that remain open for the duration. Creatures can step through one to exit the other, and you can rotate the portals as a bonus action.

spell:bones-of-the-earth.description: You cause up to six pillars of stone to burst from places on the ground that you can see. Each pillar is a cylinder that can lift creatures or crush them against ceilings if they fail a Dexterity save.

spell:create-homunculus.components: V, S, M (clay, ash, and mandrake root, all of which the spell consumes, and a jewel-encrusted dagger worth at least 1,000 gp)
spell:create-homunculus.description: You create a homunculus by performing a special ritual with rare materials. The homunculus is permanently bound to you and serves as a loyal companion.

spell:druid-grove.components: V, S, M (mistletoe, which the spell consumes, that was harvested with a golden sickle under the light of a full moon)
spell:druid-grove.description: You create a protected grove that lasts for an extended period. It provides benefits such as enhanced healing, alarm effects, and the ability to support additional plant or animal allies.

spell:fizban-s-platinum-shield.components: V, S, M (a platinum-plated dragon scale, worth at least 500 gp)
spell:fizban-s-platinum-shield.description: A field of silvery light around a creature (you included) grants half cover, resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison, and evasion on Dexterity saves. A bonus action on later turns moves the field to another creature within 60 feet.

spell:investiture-of-flame.description: Flames race across your body, shedding bright light and granting immunity to fire damage. You can use an action to create a line of fire or cause fire damage to creatures that touch or hit you.

spell:investiture-of-ice.description: Ice rimes your body, granting immunity to cold damage and the ability to create a cone of cold or make the ground icy around you.

spell:investiture-of-stone.description: You gain a rocky hide that grants resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and you can cause the earth to tremble or move through stone.

spell:investiture-of-wind.description: Wind whirls around you: ranged weapon attacks against you have disadvantage and you gain a 60-foot flying speed. As an action, a 15-foot cube of wind within 60 feet forces a Constitution save for 2d10 bludgeoning (half on success), pushing Large or smaller creatures that fail 10 feet.

spell:mental-prison.description: You attempt to bind a creature within an illusory cell that only it can perceive. On a failed Intelligence save it is trapped, taking psychic damage if it attempts to leave or if the illusion is interacted with in certain ways.

spell:primordial-ward.description: You resist acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage. When you take one of those types, a reaction swaps the resistances for immunity to that type (including the triggering damage) until the end of your next turn, when the spell ends.

spell:scatter.description: Up to five creatures you can see within range are teleported to unoccupied ground you can see within 120 feet of you; unwilling creatures can resist with a Wisdom save.

spell:soul-cage.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when a humanoid you can see within 60 feet of you dies
spell:soul-cage.components: V, S, M (a tiny silver cage worth 100 gp)
spell:soul-cage.description: You snatch the soul of a humanoid that dies within range and trap it in a tiny cage. While trapped you can use the soul to ask questions, view its memories, or exploit it for other benefits a limited number of times.

spell:summon-fiend-legacy.components: V, S, M (a bloody vial worth 600+ GP)
spell:summon-fiend-legacy.description: Summon a fiendish spirit (Demon, Devil, or Yugoloth form) that uses the Fiendish Spirit stat block, acts right after you, and obeys your verbal commands; it Dodges if given none.

spell:tasha-s-otherworldly-guise.components: V, S, M (an object engraved with a symbol of the Outer Planes, worth at least 500 gp)
spell:tasha-s-otherworldly-guise.description: Draw on the Lower or Upper Planes: immunity to fire and poison damage and the poisoned condition (Lower) or radiant and necrotic damage and the charmed condition (Upper), a 40-foot flying speed, +2 AC, magical weapon attacks that can use your spellcasting modifier, and two attacks per Attack action.

spell:tenser-s-transformation.components: V, S, M (a few hairs from a bull)
spell:tenser-s-transformation.description: You endow yourself with endurance and martial prowess. You gain temporary hit points, proficiency with martial weapons and armor, extra attacks, and other combat benefits, but cannot cast spells while transformed.

spell:crown-of-stars.description: Seven star-like motes of light appear and orbit your head. You can use a bonus action to send one mote streaking toward a creature, making a ranged spell attack that deals radiant damage.

spell:draconic-transformation.components: V, S, M (a statuette of a dragon, worth at least 500 gp)
spell:draconic-transformation.description: You channel draconic power, growing spectral wings, gaining a breath weapon, blindsight, and other dragon-like traits for the duration.

spell:dream-of-the-blue-veil.components: V, S, M (a magic item or a willing creature from the destination world)
spell:dream-of-the-blue-veil.description: You and up to eight willing creatures project your minds into a shared dream that allows travel to another world or plane connected by the blue veil, with risks if the dream is disrupted.

spell:power-word-pain-legacy.description: One creature with 100 hit points or fewer (not immune to being charmed) is wracked with pain: Speed capped at 10 feet, disadvantage on attacks, checks, and saves other than Constitution, and it must pass a Constitution save to cast a spell. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. No damage.

spell:temple-of-the-gods.components: V, S, M (a holy symbol worth at least 5 gp)
spell:temple-of-the-gods.description: You create a temple that is protected against certain creature types and provides benefits to worshippers of your deity, including enhanced healing and warding effects that last for an extended period.

spell:abi-dalzim-s-horrid-wilting.components: V, S, M (a bit of sponge)
spell:abi-dalzim-s-horrid-wilting.description: Creatures in a 30-foot cube make a Constitution save for 12d8 necrotic, half on a success; constructs and undead are unaffected, and plants and water elementals save with disadvantage. Ordinary plants there wither and die.

spell:illusory-dragon-legacy.description: A Huge shadow dragon appears within 120 feet, immune to damage and conditions. Enemies who see it make a Wisdom save or are frightened for 1 minute. As a bonus action you move it 60 feet and can breathe a 60-foot cone: Intelligence save for 7d6 of a damage type chosen at casting, half on a success. An Investigation check reveals the illusion.

spell:maddening-darkness.components: V, M (a drop of pitch mixed with a drop of mercury)
spell:maddening-darkness.description: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose, filling a 60-foot-radius sphere. Creatures in the darkness take psychic damage at the start of their turns on a failed Wisdom save, and the darkness can't be illuminated by nonmagical means.

spell:mighty-fortress.components: V, S, M (a diamond worth at least 500 gp, which the spell consumes)
spell:mighty-fortress.description: You conjure a fortress of stone that fills a square area. It has multiple floors, defensive features, and remains for seven days or until you dismiss it. Creatures inside are protected from weather and some magical detection.

spell:telepathy-legacy.components: V, S, M (a pair of linked silver rings)
spell:telepathy-legacy.description: You create a telepathic link between yourself and a willing creature. You can communicate telepathically across any distance as long as you are on the same plane, and the link lasts until you dismiss it or one of you dies.

spell:tsunami-legacy.description: A wall of water 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick appears and surges forward. Creatures caught in it must succeed on a Strength save or take bludgeoning damage and be swept away; the water continues moving for several turns.

spell:blade-of-disaster-legacy.description: A 3-foot planar rift makes two melee spell attacks on casting (4d12 force each, crits on 18 or higher for an extra 8d12) and, as a bonus action each turn, moves 30 feet and attacks twice again. It passes through any barrier, including a wall of force.

spell:invulnerability-legacy.components: V, S, M (a piece of adamantine worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes)
spell:invulnerability-legacy.description: You have Immunity to all damage for up to 10 minutes. Consumes a 500 GP piece of adamantine.

spell:mass-polymorph.description: You transform up to ten creatures of your choice within range into new forms of challenge rating equal to or less than their own. Unwilling creatures must succeed on a Wisdom save to resist.

spell:power-word-heal-legacy.description: A wave of healing energy washes over a creature you can see. It regains all its hit points and is cured of certain conditions such as charmed, frightened, paralyzed, or stunned.

spell:psychic-scream.description: You unleash the power of your mind to blast the intellect of up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see. On a failed Intelligence save a target takes psychic damage and is stunned.

spell:chaos-bolt.description: Ranged spell attack against one creature: 2d8 + 1d6 damage. Pick one of the d8s; its number sets the type (1 Acid, 2 Cold, 3 Fire, 4 Force, 5 Lightning, 6 Poison, 7 Psychic, 8 Thunder). If both d8s match, the bolt leaps to a different creature of your choice within 30 feet of the target: new attack, new damage, and it can leap again. Each creature can be targeted only once per casting. +1d6 per slot level above 1st, to each target.

spell:dust-devil.components: V, S, M (a pinch of dust)
spell:dust-devil.description: A dust devil fills an unoccupied 5-foot cube of air in range. A creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of it makes a Strength save: 1d8 bludgeoning and pushed 10 feet on a failure, half damage and no push on a success. As a bonus action you move it up to 30 feet; passing over sand, dust, loose dirt or small gravel, it raises a 10-foot-radius cloud of debris that heavily obscures the area until the start of your next turn. +1d8 per slot level above 2nd.

spell:whirlwind.description: A 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder of wind on the ground in range; your action moves it up to 30 feet along the ground, and it picks up unsecured Medium or smaller objects. A creature makes a Dexterity save the first time on a turn it enters the whirlwind or the whirlwind enters its space: 10d6 bludgeoning, half on a success. A Large or smaller creature that fails also makes a Strength save or is restrained inside, rising 5 feet at the start of each of its turns, moving with it and falling when the spell ends. As an action it can make a Strength or Dexterity check against your spell save DC to break free, then is flung 3d6 x 10 feet in a random direction.

spell:sword-burst.description: Spectral blades sweep around you: every other creature within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 force. The damage rises to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th and 4d6 at 17th.

spell:antagonize-legacy.components: V, S, M (a playing card depicting a rogue)
spell:antagonize-legacy.description: One creature in range makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it takes 4d4 psychic damage and must at once use its reaction to make a melee attack against another creature you choose and can see; if it can't, it instead has disadvantage on its next attack roll before your next turn starts. On a success it takes half damage only. +1d4 per slot level above 3rd.

spell:spirit-of-death-legacy.components: V, S, M (a gilded playing card worth 400+ gp depicting an avatar of death)
spell:spirit-of-death-legacy.description: A reaper spirit appears in an unoccupied space you can see in range, using the reaper spirit stat block, until it drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends. It is your ally, acts right after you on your initiative, and follows your verbal commands (no action); without commands it Dodges and avoids danger. Cast with a higher slot, use that level wherever the stat block refers to the spell's level.

spell:spray-of-cards-legacy.components: V, S, M (a deck of cards)
spell:spray-of-cards-legacy.description: Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 2d10 force damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn; on a success it takes half damage only. +1d10 per slot level above 2nd.

spell:borrowed-knowledge.components: V, S, M (a book worth at least 25 gp)
spell:borrowed-knowledge.description: Gain proficiency in one skill you lack for the duration; casting it again ends the previous casting.

spell:kinetic-jaunt.description: +10 feet walking speed, no opportunity attacks against you, and you move through creatures' spaces without it counting as difficult terrain; ending your turn in one shunts you back to your last free space and deals you 1d8 force.

spell:vortex-warp.description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save (it can choose to fail) or you teleport it to an unoccupied space you can see within range that can support it. +30 feet range per slot level above 2nd.

spell:wither-and-bloom-legacy.components: V, S, M (a withered vine twisted into a loop)
spell:wither-and-bloom-legacy.description: Creatures of your choice in a 10-foot-radius sphere make a Constitution save, 2d6 necrotic (half on success); nonmagical plants wither. One creature there can spend and roll a Hit Die, healing that plus your spellcasting modifier. Per slot level above 2nd: +1d6 damage and one more Hit Die.

spell:air-bubble.description: A willing creature you can see gets a globe of fresh air around its head (one head, if it has several) for the duration, preventing suffocation. Two more globes per slot level above 2nd.

spell:create-spelljamming-helm.components: V, S, M (a crystal rod worth at least 5,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
spell:create-spelljamming-helm.description: Holding the rod, you touch an unoccupied Large or smaller chair; the rod vanishes and the chair becomes a spelljamming helm.

spell:sapping-sting.description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save or takes 1d4 necrotic and falls prone. Damage rises to 2d4 at 5th level, 3d4 at 11th and 4d4 at 17th.

spell:gift-of-alacrity.description: A willing creature you touch adds 1d8 to its initiative rolls for the duration.

spell:magnify-gravity.description: Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere make a Constitution save: 2d8 force and half speed until the end of their next turn, or half damage only. Until your next turn, unattended objects there need a Strength check against your spell save DC to move. +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

spell:fortune-s-favor.components: V, S, M (a white pearl worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes)
spell:fortune-s-favor.description: You or a willing creature can end the spell to roll an extra d20 on an attack roll, check or save, or when attacked, choosing which die to use (rolled after advantage or disadvantage). One more target per slot level above 2nd.

spell:immovable-object.components: V, S, M (gold dust worth at least 25 gp, which the spell consumes)
spell:immovable-object.description: An object of 10 pounds or less is fixed in place; you and creatures you name can move it, and a password spoken within 5 feet suppresses the spell for 1 minute. In the air it holds up to 4,000 pounds; otherwise an action and a Strength check against your spell save DC moves it 10 feet. At 4th or 5th level: DC +5, 8,000 pounds, 24 hours. At 6th or higher: DC +10, 20,000 pounds, permanent until dispelled.

spell:wristpocket.description: An object of 5 pounds or less in your hand vanishes into an extradimensional space; as an action you can summon it to your free hand or send it back. It appears at your feet when the spell ends.

spell:pulse-wave.description: Each creature in the cone makes a Constitution save, 6d6 force, half on success; those that fail are pulled 15 feet toward you or pushed 15 feet away (your choice), as are unsecured objects fully in the cone. +1d6 and +5 feet per slot level above 3rd.

spell:gravity-sinkhole.description: Creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere make a Constitution save: 5d10 force and pulled to the space nearest the center (even in the air), or half damage and no pull. +1d10 per slot level above 4th.

spell:temporal-shunt.castingTime: 1 reaction, when a creature you can see makes an attack roll or starts to cast a spell
spell:temporal-shunt.description: The triggering creature makes a Wisdom save or vanishes into another moment, its attack missing or spell wasted; it reappears at the start of its next turn in its space or the nearest free one, remembering nothing of it. One more target per slot level above 5th, all within 30 feet of each other.

spell:gravity-fissure.components: V, S, M (a fistful of iron filings)
spell:gravity-fissure.description: Creatures in a 100-foot by 5-foot line make a Constitution save, 8d8 force, half on success. Creatures within 10 feet of the line make a Constitution save or take 8d8 force and are pulled into it. +1d8 per slot level above 6th.

spell:tether-essence.components: V, S, M (a spool of platinum cord worth at least 250 gp, which the spell consumes)
spell:tether-essence.description: Two creatures you can see make Constitution saves (disadvantage if within 30 feet of each other; either can fail willingly). If both fail, damage and healing to one apply equally to the other until either drops to 0 HP or the spell ends for both.

spell:dark-star.components: V, S, M (a shard of onyx and a drop of your blood, both consumed)
spell:dark-star.description: A sphere of radius up to 40 feet fills with magical darkness (darkvision can't pierce it, nonmagical light fails) and crushing gravity: difficult terrain, total silence (creatures inside are deafened and immune to thunder, and verbal spells are impossible). A creature entering for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a Constitution save, 8d10 force, half on success; one reduced to 0 HP is disintegrated with its nonmagical gear.

spell:reality-break.description: A creature makes a Wisdom save or can't take reactions and rolls a d10 at the start of each of its turns: 1-2, 6d12 psychic and stunned until the end of the turn; 3-5, Dexterity save, 8d12 force, half on success; 6-8, teleported up to 30 feet to a space you choose, 10d12 force and prone; 9-10, 10d12 cold and blinded until the end of the turn. It repeats the save at the end of each turn to end the spell.

spell:ravenous-void.components: V, S, M (a small, nine-pointed iron star)
spell:ravenous-void.description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of gravity appears; it and everything within 100 feet of it is difficult terrain, and unattended nonmagical objects inside are destroyed. When it appears and at the start of each of your turns, unsecured objects within 100 feet are drawn to its center. A creature starting its turn within 100 feet makes a Strength save or is pulled to the center. A creature entering the sphere for the first time on a turn or starting there takes 5d10 force and is restrained while inside (an action and a Strength check against your spell save DC frees one in reach). A creature reduced to 0 HP is annihilated with its nonmagical gear.

spell:time-ravage.components: V, S, M (an hourglass of diamond dust worth at least 5,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
spell:time-ravage.description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save, 10d12 necrotic, half on success. On a failure it also ages until it has 30 days to live, with disadvantage on attack rolls, checks and saves and half walking speed; only wish or a 9th-level greater restoration reverses this.

spell:distort-value.description: An object up to 1 foot on a side seems worth double or half its value through illusory polish or wear; an Int (Investigation) check against your spell save DC reveals its true worth. +1 foot of size per slot level above 1st.

spell:jim-s-magic-missile.description: Three darts each make a ranged spell attack against creatures you can see in range, dealing 2d4 force on a hit, or 5d4 force on a critical hit. If any attack roll is a 1, all darts miss and explode on you for 1 force each. One more dart and +1 gp royalty per slot level above 1st. Royalty component: the listed gold must be on your person and is magically sent to the spell's creator when cast; without it you can't cast the spell.

spell:gift-of-gab.castingTime: 1 reaction, when you speak to another creature
spell:gift-of-gab.description: Chosen creatures within 5 feet forget what you said in the last 6 seconds and instead remember the words you speak as this spell's verbal component. Royalty component: the listed gold must be on your person and is magically sent to the spell's creator when cast; without it you can't cast the spell.

spell:jim-s-glowing-coin.description: The thrown coin glows like light; chosen creatures you can see within 30 feet of it make a Wisdom save or are distracted for the duration, with disadvantage on Wis (Perception) checks and initiative rolls. Royalty component: the listed gold must be on your person and is magically sent to the spell's creator when cast; without it you can't cast the spell.

spell:fast-friends.description: A Humanoid that can see, hear and understand you makes a Wisdom save or is charmed, cheerfully doing tasks you set. A task that would harm it or go against its nature allows a new save (with advantage if you or your allies are fighting it), and a task meaning certain death ends the spell. It knows it was charmed afterward. One more target per slot level above 3rd.

spell:incite-greed.components: V, S, M (a gem worth at least 50 gp)
spell:incite-greed.description: Any number of creatures in range that can see you make a Wisdom save or are charmed until the spell ends or you or your allies harm them, able only to approach you safely and then stand staring at the gem once within 5 feet. Each repeats the save at the end of its turns.

spell:motivational-speech.description: Up to five creatures that can hear you gain 5 temporary HP and advantage on Wisdom saves, and when hit by an attack have advantage on their next attack roll; the spell ends for a creature when those temporary HP are gone. +5 temporary HP per slot level above 3rd.

spell:conjure-tools-legacy.description: A set of Artisan's Tools of your choice appears, and you are proficient with them. They vanish when the spell ends (anything made with them stays), and the spell ends early if you recast it or move more than 10 feet from them. With a level 3 slot, you craft nonmagical items as fast as two characters.
