spell:feign-interest-legacy.description: You look fully focused and attentive for the duration, whatever you are really doing, even napping. A creature that uses a Search action to read your state of mind sees through it with a Wisdom (Insight) check against your spell save DC.

spell:pinky-swear-legacy.description: You touch a creature and make a promise of up to 25 words. If you knowingly break it during the spell, the target learns of it if within 1 mile, and you catch fire, taking 1 Fire damage at the start of each of your turns.

spell:quick-clothier-legacy.components: V, S, M (a set of clothing)
spell:quick-clothier-legacy.description: You restyle a set of nonmagical clothing no one else is wearing: color, cut, decoration and form, worth up to 15 GP (rags to fine clothes, or the reverse). It reverts when the spell ends.

spell:searing-orb-legacy.components: S, M (metallic flakes and a pinch of phosphorus)
spell:searing-orb-legacy.description: Ranged spell attack against one creature: 3d4 Radiant on a hit. Hit or miss, the orb bursts; the target and each creature within 10 feet of it make a Constitution save or have the Blinded condition until the end of their next turn. +1d4 per slot level above 2.

spell:tortoise-shell-legacy.description: A willing creature you touch grows a hard shell and gains +3 AC. If it moves or uses its action, bonus action, or reaction, the bonus drops to +1 until the start of its next turn.

spell:void-star-legacy.components: V, S, M (a fragment of a meteorite)
spell:void-star-legacy.description: Ranged spell attack against one creature you can see: 6d12 Necrotic on a hit. Hit or miss, it takes 3d12 Necrotic at the end of its next turn and you regain that many Hit Points. Both amounts +1d12 per slot level above 7.

spell:astral-flood-legacy.components: V, S, M (a mixture of water and powdered silver)
spell:astral-flood-legacy.description: Pick Cold or Radiant. Each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Dexterity save: 4d10 of that type on a failure (half on a success). A failed save against Cold also gives Disadvantage on its next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw before the end of your next turn; against Radiant, the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn. +1d10 per slot level above 3.

spell:buzzing-bee-legacy.components: V, S, M (a dab of honey)
spell:buzzing-bee-legacy.description: A loud spectral bee hovers around a creature you can see. It has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks, Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and Concentration saves, and gains no benefit from the Invisible condition. The bee ends if the target goes more than 120 feet from you.

spell:insidious-rhythm-legacy.description: A creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on Intelligence checks and Concentration saves as a tune loops in its head. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. One extra target per slot level above 1.

spell:leomund-s-lamentable-belaborment-l.description: You make a provocative statement. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere within range makes an Intelligence save or is Charmed for the duration (no shared language or Intelligence under 3 means automatic success). A Charmed target spends its turns arguing the point, has Speed 0, and is Blinded and Deafened to everyone but you and other targets. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

spell:sticks-to-snakes-legacy.components: V, S, M (a small piece of bark and several snake scales)
spell:sticks-to-snakes-legacy.description: Up to four nonmagical sticks (quarterstaff size or smaller wood such as torches or spears) you can see become Venomous Snakes; a creature holding one can make a Charisma save to stop it. The snakes are Friendly to you, act right after you, and obey your bonus action commands within 500 feet, otherwise Dodging. At 0 HP a snake reverts, extra damage carrying to the object. Two more objects per slot level above 4.

spell:bloodletter-2014.description: A nonmagical weapon you touch festers the next creature it hits: Constitution save or it takes 2d6 necrotic at the start of each of its turns for the duration (one wound at a time). Any magical healing ends it. +1d6 per slot level above 2nd.

spell:creeping-touch-2014.description: Your hand detaches and becomes a spider you can talk to telepathically within 100 feet; as an action you see and hear through it until your next turn, blind and deaf to your own surroundings. Call it back to end the spell. If it dies or can't return, your hand regrows and you take 1d6 psychic.

spell:crown-of-radiance-2014.description: A crown of holy fire sheds bright light 30 feet and dim light 30 more. Any fiend, fey, or undead that moves within 20 feet of you or starts its turn there takes 2d8 radiant.

spell:flense-2014.description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save, taking 8d6 necrotic or half on success. Each turn you can use your action to repeat it. Ends if the target leaves range, drops to 0 hit points, or gains total cover.

spell:holy-word-2014.description: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 radiant. An undead, fiend, or fey hit also loses 10 feet of speed and can't take reactions until the end of its next turn. Damage rises to 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th, and 4d8 at 17th.

spell:life-tether-2014.description: A creature makes a Wisdom save or is tethered to you; whenever you take damage it takes half as much (after resistances) as necrotic. When a tethered creature drops to 0, a bonus action moves the tether to a new target (Wisdom save). One more tether per two slot levels above 2nd.

spell:phoenix-flames-2014.description: You burn away in holy fire: creatures within 20 feet make a Constitution save, taking 30d6 radiant and a level of exhaustion, or half damage only on success. Creatures killed are incinerated. Ten minutes later you rise as if by true resurrection.

spell:ride-the-lightning-2014.components: V, S, M (a length of copper wire)
spell:ride-the-lightning-2014.description: Teleport up to 60 feet as a lightning bolt; creatures within 5 feet of the path make a Dexterity save, 4d6 lightning or half. +1d6 damage and +10 feet of distance per slot level above 4th.

spell:spirit-swarm-2014.description: A creature with Charisma 3 or higher makes a Charisma save: 8d8 psychic and frightened of you for the duration, or half damage only on success.

spell:supernal-smite-2014.description: Your next melee weapon hit during the spell deals +4d6 force, breaks the target's concentration, and ends its spells of 3rd level or lower; for each higher spell on it, make a spellcasting check against DC 10 + its level to end it.

spell:bitter-wind.components: V, S, M (a birch wood fan)
spell:bitter-wind.description: A freezing wind 120 feet long and 20 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose. A creature starting its turn in the line makes a Strength save or is pushed 30 feet along the line, takes 1d12 cold, and is knocked prone; the save has disadvantage in cold weather or dark or shadowy conditions. Moving toward you inside the line costs 2 feet per foot. A bonus action each turn changes the direction. The wind disperses gas and puts out unprotected flames. At 4th level or higher the save always has disadvantage and damage rises 1d12 per slot level above 3rd.

spell:blade-of-blood-and-bone.components: V, S, M (a dagger or shortsword, not consumed)
spell:blade-of-blood-and-bone.description: You cut yourself with the material component; your hit point maximum drops by 3 and the component vanishes. For the duration, a bonus action draws a magic blade of bone and blood from your body (or sheathes it back). You are proficient with it, attack with your spell attack bonus, and deal 1d6 slashing on a hit. When the spell ends your maximum and the component are restored. With a higher slot, damage rises 1d6 per two slot levels above 2nd and your maximum drops by an extra amount equal to the slot level.

spell:bright-sparks.description: Blue sparks fly from your fingers, lighting the area within 60 feet until the start of your next turn. Wisdom (Perception) checks to spot creatures hidden in shadows have advantage.

spell:charnel-banquet.description: You turn a field of carrion into an empowering feast. Creatures of your choice that eat of it during the duration regain 10d6 hit points, recover half their spent Hit Dice (minimum 1), remove half their exhaustion levels (minimum 1), and gain the benefits of a short rest. At the end of the duration each makes a Constitution save or is poisoned for 1 hour. With a 9th-level slot they instead remove all exhaustion and recover all Hit Dice.

spell:child-of-light-and-darkness.components: V, S, M (a sun-warmed pebble from the Shadow Realm)
spell:child-of-light-and-darkness.description: At the end of each of your turns roll a d20: on 1 to 10 you become a humanoid of searing light, on 11 to 20 one of chilling darkness. In either form you are immune to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and attacks against you have disadvantage. Light form: bright light 60 feet and dim 60 more, immunity to fire, resistance to radiant, and once per turn a bonus action teleports you to a space you can see within your light. Darkness form: immunity to cold, resistance to necrotic, and once per turn a bonus action forces up to three Large or smaller creatures within 30 feet to make a Strength save or be pulled or pushed up to 20 feet.

spell:conjure-ferryman.components: V, S, M (a couple of copper coins)
spell:conjure-ferryman.description: Standing at a riverbank or other shore, you summon a friendly ferry spirit and its boat in an unoccupied space within range. It rolls initiative, carries you and up to one companion per your level across the water or along it, and otherwise only defends itself. It vanishes at 0 hit points or when the spell ends. If your concentration breaks it turns hostile and lingers for 1 hour. The GM has its statistics (a lesser lunar devil or bearded devil). At 3rd level or higher the boat can cross into the Ethereal Plane and out onto another body of water; at 5th level or higher it can travel the River Styx between planes.

spell:conjure-giant.description: You summon a giant of challenge rating 7 or lower in an unoccupied space within range. It is friendly, rolls initiative, obeys your verbal commands (no action required) that don't violate its alignment, and otherwise only defends itself. It vanishes at 0 hit points or when the spell ends. If your concentration breaks it becomes hostile and can't be dismissed, vanishing 1 hour after it was summoned. The GM has its statistics. The challenge rating rises by 1 per slot level above 6th.

spell:deep-roots-of-the-moon.components: V, M (moonstones worth 50 gp per mile within the Shadow Realm, or opals worth 500 gp per mile crossing planes)
spell:deep-roots-of-the-moon.description: You bind shadow material into an enchanted fey road (a shadow road) fixed between two points, resistant to weather and mundane change but subject to wear, deliberate destruction, and dispel magic. You can attach a keyword prayer or offering; those who know it can add one or two effects, such as doubled overland travel speed on the road or locking and unlocking its portals outside the Shadow Realm. Without it, no one can enter the road from outside the Shadow Realm.

spell:doom-of-false-friends.components: V, S, M (a pink rose petal)
spell:doom-of-false-friends.description: Two creatures within range that can see and hear you each make a Charisma save. On a failure a target must use its movement and action to move toward and attack the other target, seeking it out if it leaves range. At the end of each turn a target can't see the other, it repeats the save, ending the compulsion on a success. Once every target has succeeded, you are stunned until the end of your next turn. With a 9th-level slot you can target two more creatures, and each chooses on its turn which other target to attack.

spell:doom-of-poor-fortune.description: You turn luck against a creature within range. Whenever it makes an ability check, it first makes a Charisma save or the check fails; the spell persists if it leaves range. Each time it still succeeds on an affected roll you take 1 psychic damage, and losing concentration deals you 1d4 psychic. At 2nd level or higher, its other saving throws are replaced by a Charisma save unless the original is harder. At 4th level or higher it must also pass a Charisma save before each attack roll or the attack fails. With an 8th-level slot the spell no longer requires concentration.

spell:doom-of-stacked-stones.description: You and three creatures of your choice within range make a Constitution save when you cast it and at the start of each of your turns; a failure restrains the creature. When an initial target fails, up to two other creatures within 30 feet of it must save too. Each further failure worsens the condition one step: restrained, incapacitated, stunned, paralyzed, then petrified (conditions stack), and each success lowers it one step. A target other than you that succeeds while only restrained is freed. You must keep saving every round. Creatures recover when the spell ends except petrified ones, which stay stone until restored by dispel magic, greater restoration, or similar magic; shatter can kill a petrified creature that fails a Constitution save.

spell:doom-of-summer-years.components: V, S, M (a pinch of sand from an hourglass)
spell:doom-of-summer-years.description: A living creature within range makes a Constitution save when you cast it and at the start of each of your turns, growing 1d4 + 1 years younger on a success or 1 year younger on a failure, down to infancy. It keeps its memories, scores, and features but gains 1 level of exhaustion per 5 years lost. A Medium creature reduced to childhood can't use heavy weapons, and an infant can't wield weapons or tools. If the spell ends before 1 minute the target returns to its true age; otherwise the change is permanent until ended by remove curse or greater restoration. If you lose concentration unintentionally, you gain as many exhaustion levels as the target gained.

spell:drayfn-s-bane-of-excellence.description: A creature within range makes a Charisma save. On a failure, the next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes during the duration on which it rolls a natural 20 has no effect. The number of natural 20s negated rises to two at 5th level, three at 11th, and four at 17th.

spell:drayfn-s-blunted-blade.components: V, S, M (a rusty shard of iron)
spell:drayfn-s-blunted-blade.description: A creature within range holding a manufactured, nonmagical weapon makes a Strength save. On a failure the weapon corrodes: the target rolls all weapon damage dice twice and uses the lower result. If the spell lasts the full minute the weapon crumbles to rust or wood chips; otherwise it returns to normal.

spell:drayfn-s-curse-of-incompetence.description: A creature within range with Intelligence 3 or higher makes an Intelligence save or can't add its proficiency bonus to ability checks, attack rolls, or saving throws. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Duration becomes concentration up to 10 minutes with a 5th-level slot, concentration up to 1 hour with a 6th-level slot, and 1 hour without concentration with a 7th-level slot.

spell:drizzle.description: A very light rain falls on a 20-foot square, too little to drink or to douse anything larger than a candle. After 1 minute the ground is wet; after 10 minutes it is slightly muddy or slippery without impeding movement. In freezing weather it may leave a thin coat of ice.

spell:ebon-tide.components: V, S, M (a bottle of shadows)
spell:ebon-tide.description: A wave of shadow matter whips a 100-foot-radius circle centered on a point you can see within range. The area is difficult terrain, and each creature touching the ground makes a Constitution save or gains a level of exhaustion. When you cast it and at the end of each turn you concentrate, creatures on the ground in the area make a Dexterity save or fall prone. Structures in contact with the ground take 30 bludgeoning when you cast it and at the start of each of your turns; a structure reduced to 0 sinks into the Shadow Realm, and creatures inside make a Constitution save, taking 2d12 necrotic, falling prone, and being blinded for 1 round on a failure (half damage only on a success). The GM may add up to two terrain effects: rising hills, slip faults, and hollows; rerouted rivers or shores; or turning the area to shadow mire.

spell:elf-shot.description: You mime shooting a tiny bow. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit it stumbles 5 feet in a random direction (d8) and its speed is 0 until the end of its next turn. You can repeat the attack as an action on each of your turns until the spell ends.

spell:emerald-goblet.components: V, S, M (a powdered acorn, which the spell consumes, and a drinking vessel)
spell:emerald-goblet.description: You sprinkle acorn dust into a drinking vessel, creating a shining green goblet of green potion. A creature that drinks from it is protected against shadow corruption for 1 day, has advantage on checks to gather food in the Shadow Realm, and gains darkvision to 30 feet (or extends its darkvision by 30 feet).

spell:faerie-toast.components: V, S, M (wine worth 100 gp, which the spell consumes, and a cup for each participant)
spell:faerie-toast.description: You and up to five creatures within 10 feet drink a toast to the fey courts; choose one toast. Commiseration: spellcasting participants form a hag coven, sharing spell slots and all known spells for the duration. Friendship: participants become fey and their status rises by 2d6 in the Shadow Realm or the Bright Lands. Husbandry: participants can communicate with beasts as if sharing a language. Nightmares: the first time a creature comes within 30 feet of a participant it makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of all participants for 1 minute. Playfulness: participants grow gossamer wings and gain a fly speed equal to their walking speed for 10 rounds within the duration, falling if not on a surface at the end of their turn. Restfulness: participants have advantage on saves against being charmed and can't be magically put to sleep.

spell:feast-of-flesh.components: V, M (an animal tooth and a drop of your blood)
spell:feast-of-flesh.description: A creature within range makes a Charisma save. On a failure its teeth turn needlelike, it can pinpoint creatures of its own type within 150 feet by scent, and on its turn it must move toward the nearest one by the fastest means and, if within 5 feet, use its bonus action to bite it (proficient, 1d6 + its Strength modifier). With none of its type within 150 feet, it attacks the closest living creature instead. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage (with advantage when triggered by damage); on a success the spell ends and it is poisoned for 1 hour unless it is a cannibal or from a cannibalistic culture.

spell:fire-dance.components: S, M (a burning mass of rags, a pair of torches, or similar fire in both hands)
spell:fire-dance.description: You twirl two sources of fire in glowing patterns. Creatures of your choice in range that see the dance make a Wisdom save; creatures that can't be charmed succeed automatically, and a creature you or your companions are fighting has advantage. On a failure a creature is charmed, incapacitated, and has speed 0 for the duration. The effect ends for a creature that takes damage or is shaken out of it with an action, and the spell ends if you are incapacitated.

spell:fireflies.description: A swarm of fireflies lights a 15-foot-radius sphere within range for the duration. Some settle on hidden or invisible creatures: attack rolls against invisible creatures in the area don't have disadvantage (their own attacks still have advantage), and Hide actions in the area have disadvantage.

spell:flowering.description: Fragrant flowers sprout from an inanimate object within range. If an unwilling creature holds it, that creature can make a Dexterity save to negate the effect. If sustained for 1 minute, the flowers give a pleasing scent and may draw bees, hummingbirds, and other pollinators.

spell:gloaming.components: V, M (a piece of smoked glass)
spell:gloaming.description: Magical gloom fills a 50-foot-radius sphere around a point within range, spreading around corners. Darkvision sees through it and normal light illuminates it, but ranged attacks made through it have disadvantage. Cast on a worn or carried object, it moves with the object, and covering the object with something opaque blocks it. Light from a spell of 2nd level or higher that overlaps the area dispels it.

spell:grim-harvest.components: V, S, M (a pinch of gray sand and a bone chip)
spell:grim-harvest.description: Target a creature at 0 hit points that is dying or died within the last round; if dying, it makes a Constitution save or dies. The next spell you cast within 1 minute grants you 1d10 + your spellcasting ability modifier temporary hit points and adds one effect of your choice. Clumsiness: target's speed is halved and it has disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saves for 1 minute (Constitution save at the end of each of its turns ends it). Fatiguing: target makes a Constitution save, gaining 1d4 levels of exhaustion on a failure or 1 on a success. Vampiric: you regain hit points equal to half the damage you dealt to one target. Weakness: target's melee hits deal minimum damage for 1 minute (Constitution save at the end of each of its turns ends it). Withering: the spell deals 4 extra damage dice and all its damage becomes necrotic.

spell:grim-shadows.description: Spear-like shadows fill a 15-foot square within range, giving creatures inside half cover. A creature entering the area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 piercing and is blinded until the spell ends; an already blinded creature starting its turn there takes 1d8 piercing. A blinded creature can use its action to make a Dexterity or Wisdom save against your spell save DC, regaining sight on a success.

spell:hero-of-fable.components: V, M (a crown of laurel leaves)
spell:hero-of-fable.description: A creature within range gains advantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws for the duration, but creatures that attack it or save against its spells and effects also have advantage. An unwilling target can resist with a Charisma save. You can target one additional creature per slot level above 6th.

spell:hibernation.components: V, M (a tuft of bear fur)
spell:hibernation.description: The next creature you touch regains 1d6 hit points and falls asleep for 10 minutes per hit point regained. An unwilling creature makes a Constitution save to resist and repeats it at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success. A sleeper stays unconscious until the spell ends, it takes damage, or someone uses an action to wake it. Undead and creatures immune to being charmed are unaffected. At 3rd level or higher you can touch one willing creature per slot level.

spell:knife-of-fate.description: You point your dagger at a creature you can see within 60 feet, which makes a Wisdom save. On a failure its fate is bound to a random ally of its own: any damage or condition either suffers is instead inflicted on the other. A creature can be bound to only one other at a time. The binding lasts until either creature gains a level, is targeted by heal, or partakes of heroes' feast.

spell:krail-s-maggot.description: A 6-inch maggot forms inside a creature within range. Make a melee spell attack; on a hit the target takes necrotic damage equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier, and you can repeat the attack as a bonus action on each later turn. As an action the target can attack the maggot (AC equal to your spell save DC, 8 hit points per slot level) with a piercing or slashing weapon; half the damage hits the maggot and half the target. Killing the maggot ends the spell. Damage rises 1d8 per slot level above 2nd.

spell:krail-s-rot.components: S, M (a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust)
spell:krail-s-rot.description: A creature within range makes a Constitution save or takes 3d8 necrotic at the start of each of its turns for the duration; if reduced to 0 hit points it has disadvantage on death saves. If it dies, a bonus action raises it as a zombie under your control for 24 hours, commanded with a bonus action within 60 feet like animate dead; expend a 5th-level or higher slot before the 24 hours end to keep control. With a 7th-level slot the damage is 6d8 and it rises as a ghoul; with a 9th-level slot, 9d8 and a ghast.

spell:krail-s-rupture.castingTime: 1 reaction, when you are grappled or swallowed whole
spell:krail-s-rupture.description: When grappled or swallowed, you slice into the creature holding you and pass through its body, breaking the grapple. It makes a Constitution save, taking 3d12 necrotic or half on a success. If swallowed, you exit regardless of damage and fall prone within 10 feet of it. Damage rises 1d12 per slot level above 2nd.

spell:leiloch-s-arduous-shuffle.description: Creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on you with fewer hit points than you when you cast it are compelled into a swaying shuffle; creatures that can't be charmed are immune. An affected creature's movement is halved, it can't take reactions, and it can make only one weapon or spell attack on its turn. At the start of its turn it can take 1d4 levels of exhaustion to end the effect on itself; exhaustion from this spell is removed by a short rest.

spell:leiloch-s-interminable-yarn.components: V, M (a scroll containing a prepared speech)
spell:leiloch-s-interminable-yarn.description: You tell a rambling story. Creatures of your choice in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on you stop to listen (deafened creatures and those that can't be charmed are immune). While enraptured they automatically fail Intelligence (Investigation) and Wisdom (Insight and Perception) checks and their passive scores in those skills are 0. A creature can try to pull away but must succeed on a Wisdom save or fall unconscious for 1 minute. The spell ends if you are incapacitated or can't speak.

spell:leiloch-s-irritating-kazoo.description: You play a droning kazoo note. Each creature within 10 feet that can hear you makes a Constitution save. On a failure it takes 1d6 thunder at the start of each of your turns and can't cast spells with verbal components for the duration, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns to end it. On a success it takes 1d6 thunder and can't cast verbal spells until the end of its next turn.

spell:lost.description: A creature makes a Wisdom save or forgets all known locations, landmarks, and routes for the duration, even familiar ones. Remove curse or greater restoration ends it. One extra target per slot level above 3rd (all within 30 feet of each other); duration 8 hours with a 5th-level slot, 24 hours with 7th, and until dispelled with 9th.

spell:lost-and-wandering.description: As lost, and the target is also compelled to wander off at a walk, attacking only in self-defense. After 16 hours it makes another Wisdom save; on a failure it falls into an exhausted long rest. Remove curse or greater restoration ends it. One extra target per slot level above 5th (within 30 feet of each other); with a 7th-level slot the effect continues a second day (Wisdom save on waking), and with 9th it recurs every day for a week.

spell:lunar-transfer.components: V, S, M (an opal worth 500 gp, which the spell consumes)
spell:lunar-transfer.description: A moonbeam transports one sleeping creature or an object (fitting in a 10-foot cube, not held by an unwilling creature) that you can see within range to a known destination on your plane; the creature wakes on arrival. An unwilling creature makes a Wisdom save; on a success the spell fails and you arrive at the destination instead. Accuracy works like teleport: the GM rolls a d20 against your familiarity (grove or magic circle, memento, very familiar, seen casually, viewed once, description, or false destination) for on target, off target (5 x d20 miles, never more than half the distance traveled), similar area, or mishap (2d12 force and reroll). You can't target yourself.

spell:moonlight-sending.components: V, S, M (gemstones, incense, and oils worth 400+ gp burned in an alabaster bowl, which the spell consumes)
spell:moonlight-sending.description: You make an offering to summon a fiend against a distant foe; make a spell attack roll to see what comes: 1 to 4 fails; 5 to 8 a wind demon or quasit; 9 to 12 a rattok demon or bearded devil; 13 to 16 a lesser lunar devil or vrock; 17 to 20 a lunar devil or hezrou; 21 or more an alnaar or horned devil. A DC 10 Charisma (Persuasion) check compels it to seek a creature you name on your plane; on a failure it refuses and the offering is lost. If the target is warded or can't be found, a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check has it report back and vanish; on a failure it demands another offering and attacks you if you don't provide one.

spell:obfuscate-object.description: While you are in dim light, an object within range no larger than a shortsword (on your person, in hand, or unattended) becomes unobtrusive, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks to hide it. You can affect two objects at 5th level, three at 11th, and four at 17th.

spell:ominous-winds.description: Up to three creatures you can see within range make Charisma saves. Until the spell ends, each that fails subtracts 1d12 from every attack roll and saving throw it makes. One extra target per slot level above 2nd.

spell:orros-mark-of-fate.castingTime: 1 reaction, when you fail a saving throw
spell:orros-mark-of-fate.components: V, S, M (a small iron shield)
spell:orros-mark-of-fate.description: When you fail a saving throw, you succeed instead and choose a creature you can see within 30 feet to suffer the effects of your failure. You still suffer any effects of a successful save. The new target makes its own saving throw against the original effect, with disadvantage.

spell:polychromatic-bubble.components: V, S, M (a chip of soap and a drop of oil)
spell:polychromatic-bubble.description: A shimmering 5-foot-radius bubble (10 hit points, AC equal to your spell save DC) encloses a Large or smaller creature or object within range and rises 10 feet at the start of each of your turns, up to 30 feet. A creature inside can't see or hear outside and at the start of its turn makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you until the start of its next turn. A creature outside that attacks the bubble makes a Wisdom save or is charmed until the start of its next turn. One extra bubble per slot level above 4th.

spell:portho-s-portal.components: V, S, M (a silver latch or key worth 100 gp, which the spell consumes)
spell:portho-s-portal.description: You open a semicircular portal 5 to 20 feet across in a space within range, linked to a precise place in the mortal or fey realms where you have stood. Only travel through its front works, delivering travelers to the nearest unoccupied space on the other side. Deities and planar rulers can block it in their domains. With a 5th-level slot it lasts 1 week; with 6th or higher it is permanent until dispelled by radiant beacon or wish.

spell:pratfall.description: A creature within range suffers one humiliating mishap of your choice (only one at a time per creature): an oily puddle (Dexterity save or no bonus actions on its next turn); a sneeze (Constitution save or disadvantage on its first attack next turn); strobing lights (Constitution save or passive Perception halved until the end of its next turn); a clap on the ears (Constitution save to maintain concentration); or a tug on its trousers (Dexterity save or disadvantage on its next two-handed weapon attack, or loss of its shield bonus to AC until the end of its next turn).

spell:radiant-beacon.components: V, S, M (a piece of amber)
spell:radiant-beacon.description: A pillar of light fills your space and the area within 5 feet. Each other creature there makes a Constitution save, taking 4d8 radiant and being blinded until the start of your next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success; undead and oozes have disadvantage. For the duration the pillar moves with you, shedding bright sunlight in a 10-foot radius and dim light 20 feet more, visible up to 10 miles away at night.

spell:shadow-adaptation.components: V, S, M (a scrap of black cloth)
spell:shadow-adaptation.description: Your body takes on a fragment of the Shadow Realm. For the duration you are immune to shadow corruption, have resistance to necrotic damage, and have advantage on saves against effects that reduce your Strength score or hit point maximum.

spell:shadow-portal.components: V, M (a silver door latch worth 50 gp, which the spell consumes)
spell:shadow-portal.description: You create a door in a wall, cliff, tree, or similar surface within 10 feet, bound to a matching door up to 200 feet away that you can see, visualize, or describe by distance and direction. Opening and passing through the near door teleports a creature to the far one. The spell ends when the duration expires or when someone closes the far door as a bonus action. Cast at 5th level, it can open onto a shadow road, possibly requiring that road's own components.

spell:spider-song.components: V, M (a song spider's leg or a tiny lute strung with spider silk)
spell:spider-song.description: You sing and conjure shadowy webs filling a 20-foot cube within range: lightly obscured, with half cover for creatures inside. Every other round while concentrating you can create a new cube, and the old one fades 1 round later. A creature entering or starting its turn in the area makes a Dexterity save or is incapacitated while it remains in the shadows; it can make a Strength check against your spell save DC each round to break free. Daylight clears the shadows from one cube.

spell:storm-door.description: You teleport in crackling lightning up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Each creature within 5 feet of both where you left and where you arrive makes a Dexterity save, taking 1d12 lightning or half on a success. As a bonus action on each of your turns you can do it again. Outdoors, a storm gathers within 1 minute and follows you, raising the damage to 2d12 and the range to 240 feet. At 5th level or higher one creature of your choice within 5 feet can travel with you, unharmed by the lightning.

spell:ugly-duckling.components: V, S, M (a shard of mirror)
spell:ugly-duckling.description: A creature within range makes a Charisma save. On a failure it has disadvantage on Charisma checks and anyone it speaks to is indifferent to it for the duration. If it succeeds on a Charisma check while affected, it can repeat the save to end the effect. One extra target per slot level above 2nd.

spell:acid-rain.components: V, S, M (a drop of acid)
spell:acid-rain.description: Acid rain fills a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-tall cylinder centered within range. Creatures in it make a Dexterity save, 4d6 acid or half on a success, and again when they first enter it on a turn or end their turn there. +1d6 per slot level above 3rd.

spell:arcanomagnetic-repulsion.description: Attacks against you with ferrous weapons or ammunition have disadvantage, and the area within 20 feet of you is difficult terrain for creatures made of or wearing ferrous metal. When you cast it and as a bonus action on later turns, one Huge or smaller creature in that difficult terrain makes a Strength save or takes 1d6 force and falls prone. +5 feet radius and +1d6 per slot level above 2nd.

spell:arcanomagnetic-storm.components: V, S, M (a piece of bismuth)
spell:arcanomagnetic-storm.description: A storm fills up to ten connected 10-foot cubes within range; as a bonus action at the start of each turn you can move one cube. A creature starting its turn in it or entering it for the first time on a turn makes a Dexterity save, 4d8 lightning or half. A creature ending its turn there makes a Strength save, 4d8 force and prone or half and not prone (disadvantage if made of or wearing ferrous metal). The area is difficult terrain for ferrous creatures. Both damages +1d8 per slot level above 7th.

spell:aura-of-impurity.description: A 30-foot aura moves with you. Creatures of your choice that enter it for the first time on a turn or start their turn there make a Charisma save or are drained until the end of their next turn: subtract 1d4 from ability checks, attack rolls, and saves, and halve hit points regained.

spell:blinding-radiance.components: V, S, M (a strip of magnesium)
spell:blinding-radiance.description: You shed bright light 50 feet and dim light 50 more. A creature that first moves within 10 feet of you on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Constitution save: 3d10 radiant and blinded until the start of its next turn, or half and not blinded. +1d10 per slot level above 4th.

spell:bone-cage.components: V, S, M (the bones of at least one non-animated corpse, which the spell consumes)
spell:bone-cage.description: Bones from corpses within range form armor, granting temporary hit points per Small or larger corpse: Small 1d6+1, Medium 1d8+2, Large 1d10+5, Huge 1d12+12, Gargantuan 1d20+25. As an action later, erupt the armor, spending all remaining temporary hit points: other creatures in range make a Dexterity save, taking piercing damage equal to the amount spent or half on a success. +10 feet radius per slot level above 5th. Biomancy school in the source; necromancy is the book's alternative.

spell:can-trip.description: Until the start of your next turn, a creature you can see within range must succeed on a spellcasting ability check against your spell save DC each time it casts a cantrip, or its action is wasted (not a slot). Ends if it leaves range. Also affects 1st-level spells at 5th level, 2nd at 11th, and 3rd at 17th.

spell:chameleon-skin.components: V, S, M (red, yellow, and blue pigment)
spell:chameleon-skin.description: A creature you touch can Hide as a bonus action even when only lightly obscured. If it didn't move on its last turn, sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks to see it have disadvantage. One extra target per slot level above 1st. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:concussion.description: A creature you can see within range makes a Constitution save or takes 1d8 thunder and is deafened until the start of your next turn. 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 17th.

spell:conjure-anomaly.description: An aberration of CR 5 or lower (GM's choice) appears within range, friendly, with its own initiative, obeying your verbal commands and otherwise defending itself. It vanishes at 0 hit points or when the spell ends. If your concentration breaks it turns hostile and stays 1 hour. CR +1 per slot level above 5th.

spell:corrupting-ichor.description: Ranged spell attack: 2d8 necrotic, and until the target uses an action to wipe off the phlegm it takes 1d4 necrotic at the start of each of its turns and halves hit points it regains. The ongoing damage rises 1d4 per slot level above 1st.

spell:daydream.components: V, S, M (a tiny, four-panelled window)
spell:daydream.description: A humanoid you can see makes a Wisdom save or has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks (-5 passive) for the duration; charm-immune creatures are unaffected. It only notices the magic if it succeeds by 5 or more. Per slot level above 1st, one extra target or +30 feet of range.

spell:depth-charge.description: A thunderous pulse in a 20-foot-radius sphere: Constitution save, 7d6 thunder (9d6 if submerged) or half. Heard 300 feet away, 1,000 in liquid. +1d6 per slot level above 3rd.

spell:dreamwalk.description: Up to ten willing creatures can dream lucidly when they sleep and always know if dream targets them. Each can choose to fall asleep instantly when you cast it, even if normally immune to magical sleep.

spell:endoleech.components: V, S, M (a toenail lost to frostbite)
spell:endoleech.description: Melee spell attack: 5d6 cold, the target can't take reactions until the end of its next turn, and until then its speed drops 15 feet while yours rises 15 feet. +1d6 per slot level above 2nd. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:feverskin.components: V, S, M (a red hot chilli pepper, which the spell consumes)
spell:feverskin.description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature in reach: 6d6 fire. You can repeat the attack as an action each turn. For the duration your walking speed is +15 feet and you gain 2d6 temporary hit points at the start of each turn. +1d6 per slot level above 5th. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:frogskin.description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature in reach: 3d10 poison and poisoned until the end of your next turn; repeat as an action each turn. You have advantage to avoid being grappled or restrained and disadvantage to grapple. Creatures grappling you or grappled by you make a Constitution save at the start of their turns, 3d10 poison or half. Both damages +1d10 per slot level above 4th. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:gravity-smash.description: A 40-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn. When the spell ends, creatures inside make a Strength save: 8d10 force and prone if it lasted the full round (4d10 if it ended early), or half and not prone. +1d10 per slot level above 5th.

spell:lungburst.description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save (disadvantage if holding its breath): 7d6 thunder plus 7d6 necrotic and it begins suffocating, or half and no suffocation. It repeats the save at the end of each turn to stop suffocating; greater restoration, heal, or wish also ends it. Creatures that don't breathe are immune. Both damages +1d6 per slot level above 6th. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:magnetite-shard.components: V, S, M (a piece of magnetite)
spell:magnetite-shard.description: An icy, metallic explosion in a 20-foot-radius sphere: Dexterity save, 4d6 cold plus 3d6 piercing or half (disadvantage if made of or wearing ferrous metal). Cold +1d6 per slot level above 3rd.

spell:magnetobolt.description: Ranged spell attack: 1d6 force, and a Strength save or prone (disadvantage for ferrous creatures). 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th, 4d6 at 17th.

spell:mortiferous-pulse.description: A 5-foot-wide, 50-foot line: Dexterity save, 3d8 necrotic or half. +1d8 per slot level above 2nd. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:pins-and-needles.description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save or takes 1d8 psychic; failing by 5 or more gives it disadvantage on its next attack before the end of its next turn. 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 17th. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:preserve-2014.description: Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere within range make a Charisma save or are soulbound for the duration; one that dies while soulbound can be harvested for 24 hours. Creatures of robust essence (about CR 7+) automatically succeed; the threshold rises to potent (CR 12+) at 4th level, mythic (CR 18+) at 6th, and deific (CR 25+) at 8th. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:riptide.description: A creature you can see in water at least 2 feet deep makes a Strength save at the start of each of its turns or is dragged 30 feet in a direction you choose and has swim speed 0 until the start of its next turn. A bonus action changes the direction. Ends if it leaves range or the water.

spell:stench.description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of fumes. A creature that enters it for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Constitution save: 3d6 poison and poisoned until the end of its next turn (with disadvantage on concentration saves), or half and not poisoned. +1d6 per slot level above 3rd.

spell:swarm.description: A creature within range makes a Dexterity save or is poisoned until the end of its next turn. From 5th level a failure also deals 1d10 poison, 2d10 at 11th, 3d10 at 17th. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:switcheroo.description: A Large or smaller creature you can see makes a Charisma save (automatic success if there isn't room; willing creatures can fail) or you swap places by teleportation. +30 feet range per slot level above 3rd; Huge targets at 6th level, Gargantuan at 9th.

spell:water-whip.description: Choose at least 4 pints of water you can see within range and make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet of it: 1d6 slashing, and a Large or smaller target makes a Strength save or is pulled 10 feet toward the water. 2d6 and 15 feet at 5th level, 3d6 and 20 at 11th, 4d6 and 25 at 17th.

spell:zippit.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature within range vocalises
spell:zippit.description: The creature makes a Constitution save or its mouth fuses shut, silencing it; a spell with verbal components it was casting is lost but the slot isn't spent. At the end of each of its turns it can make a Strength save to tear free (taking 1d8 slashing), or as an action cut its mouth open with a blade (1d8 slashing). +1d8 per slot level above 3rd. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:can-t-trip.description: A willing creature you can see is immune to being prone until the end of your next turn; if it is already prone and not restrained, it stands up. Two creatures at 5th level, three at 11th, four at 17th.

spell:cannotrip.description: Each time a creature you can see tries to cast a spell of this spell's level or lower, it must succeed on a spellcasting ability check against your spell save DC or waste its action (not its slot). Inhibits one spell level higher per slot level above 1st.

spell:eelskin.description: A willing creature's unarmed strikes and natural weapons become magical, and its first such hit each turn deals +1d8 lightning. It has advantage to avoid being grappled or restrained and disadvantage to grapple. +1d8 per two slot levels above 2nd. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:endure.components: V, S, M (a gem-encrusted cockroach worth 250 gp, which the spell consumes)
spell:endure.description: A willing creature needs no food or water, ignores exhaustion and poison, and can't be incapacitated, stunned, paralyzed, or knocked unconscious. Damage that would drop it to 0 makes it roll a death save instead; three failures kill it. Afterward it gains a level of exhaustion per failed save and falls unconscious (wakeable only by wish) for as long as the spell lasted. Duration 10 minutes at 6th level, 1 hour at 7th, 8 hours at 8th, 1 day at 9th.

spell:enrage.description: Humanoids in a 20-foot-radius sphere make a Charisma save (may choose to fail) or become hostile to all creatures; a concentrating one makes a DC 10 Constitution save each turn or loses concentration. As an action, force one to use its reaction to attack a random creature in reach; if it was friendly to that creature, it can repeat the save after. A creature repeats the save when it takes damage. One extra forced attacker per slot level above 3rd.

spell:ferocious-strike.description: Make one weapon attack; on a hit it deals +1d4 of the weapon's damage type. 2d4 at 5th level, 3d4 at 11th, 4d4 at 17th. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:firther-s-shadow.description: A creature you can see makes an Intelligence save: 4d10 psychic and you learn one random fact (name, a fear, a desire, condition immunities, damage defenses, or proficiencies), or half and nothing learned. Intelligence 4 or lower succeeds automatically. If it failed, each turn your action forces another save: 4d6 psychic and another fact, or half and the spell ends. +1d10 initial and +1d6 ongoing per slot level above 3rd.

spell:fixit.components: V, S, M (adhesive tape with ducks drawn on it)
spell:fixit.description: A broken item no larger than 20 feet is whole for the duration, and if you knew its magical function and it was common, it regains its magic. Uncommon at 3rd level, rare at 5th, very rare at 7th, legendary at 9th.

spell:flare.components: V, S, M (a strip of magnesium)
spell:flare.description: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 radiant, and on a critical hit attacks against the target have advantage until the end of your next turn. Or launch it into the air to shed bright light 20 feet and dim 20 more until the end of your next turn. 2d8 and 30 feet at 5th level, 3d8 and 40 at 11th, 4d8 and 50 at 17th.

spell:flipperform.description: A willing creature grows webbed fingers and a swim speed equal to its walking speed. One extra creature and double duration per slot level above 1st. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:food-coma.components: V, S, M (a turkey drumstick and a cranberry-coloured ruby worth at least 50 gp, both of which the spell consumes)
spell:food-coma.description: A willing creature that eats the enchanted drumstick sleeps for 1 hour, waking early only from damage or greater restoration or wish. If it sleeps the full hour it wakes with all hit points restored; woken early, nothing happens. One extra drumstick per slot level above 3rd.

spell:fungal-infection.description: Creatures in a 15-foot-radius sphere make a Constitution save or are cursed with a fungus you choose, repeating the save at the end of each turn. Amanita Rotgut: 2d6 poison now, poisoned, and 2d6 at the end of each turn. Necrotising Zygomycosis: 2d8 necrotic now and at the start of each turn. Psilocybin: d4 each turn, on a 1 no move or actions. Paralysing Mucorales: stunned at the end of each turn until its next (paralyzed if it failed by 5+). Raging Henbane: charmed and attacks a random creature with its reaction. Veiled Lady: disadvantage on Dexterity saves and ranged attacks against it have advantage. Damage +1d6/+1d8 per slot level above 4th; two fungi at 6th level. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:gravity-repulsion.description: Ranged weapon attacks against you have disadvantage, and the area within 20 feet is difficult terrain for creatures you choose. When you cast it and as a bonus action later, a Huge or smaller creature within 20 feet makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet, falls prone, and takes 3d6 force. +5 feet radius, +1d6, and +5 feet pulse range per slot level above 4th.

spell:howl.description: A magically carried animal call heard for 1,000 feet. One familiar creature you choose understands its meaning and can reply the same way; others need comprehend languages or the ability to understand beasts.

spell:humperdink-s-halitosis.description: Acid fumes fill a 15-foot cone, spreading around corners: Constitution save, 3d4 acid or half. The fumes linger until the end of your next turn (or a moderate wind) and a creature ending its turn there saves again. +1d4 per slot level above 1st.

spell:incorporeality.description: A willing creature turns translucent. At the start of each of its turns it can become incorporeal until the end of the turn: advantage on Stealth, resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing, and it moves through creatures and objects as difficult terrain (ending inside one shunts it out for 1d10 force per 5 feet). Per slot level above 5th, one extra target or longer duration (10 minutes, 1 hour, 8 hours, 24 hours).

spell:inequality.components: V, S, M (a drop of blood and water, mixed)
spell:inequality.description: Choose two creatures within range to favor and disfavor; the disfavored makes a Charisma save. On a failure the favored adds 1d4 to attacks and saves and gains half its speed, while the disfavored subtracts 1d4 and has its speed halved. Ends for the pair if either falls unconscious or dies; they can't benefit from bless or suffer bane meanwhile. One extra pair per two slot levels above 2nd.

spell:influenza.description: A 30-foot cone of sneeze: Dexterity save, 3d6 poison and poisoned for the duration, or half. Poisoned creatures repeat a Constitution save at the end of each turn and roll a d12 at the start of each turn; on 3 or lower they are incapacitated by coughing until their next turn, and creatures within 5 feet make a Constitution save or catch it. +1d6 and +1 to the coughing threshold per slot level above 3rd. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:initiative.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when initiative is rolled
spell:initiative.description: A willing creature you can see is no longer surprised, or if not surprised has advantage on the initiative roll. One extra creature per slot level above 1st.

spell:mass-leech.components: V, S, M (a live leech that has fed on humanoid blood in the past 24 hours)
spell:mass-leech.description: Creatures of your choice within 20 feet make a Constitution save, 2d8 necrotic or half. You regain hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt to Small or larger creatures. +1d8 per slot level above 3rd.

spell:mechamagic.components: V, S, M (adhesive tape with gorillas drawn on it)
spell:mechamagic.description: An item gains a property for its wearer. Armor: 1d4 temporary hit points each turn. Belt: fly speed 30 feet. Boots: +10 feet speed and triple jump distance. Cloak: advantage on Stealth to hide and can hide when lightly obscured. Gloves: climb speed equal to walking speed, spider-climbing, and advantage on grapple checks. Headwear: no need to breathe, advantage against poison, and poison resistance. Ends if you touch the item or recast it. One extra item per slot level above 4th.

spell:mireball.components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of guano and mud)
spell:mireball.description: Mud explodes in a 15-foot-radius sphere: Strength save, 3d10 bludgeoning and prone, or half. For 1 minute the first time a creature moves through the mud on a turn it makes a Dexterity save or falls prone, unless moving at half speed. +1d10 per slot level above 3rd.

spell:peppermint-plate.components: V, S, M (well-chewed peppermint chewing gum)
spell:peppermint-plate.description: +1 AC, and a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 1d4 fire (once per turn). +1d4 per slot level above 1st.

spell:power-word-shield.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can see is the target of an attack or spell
spell:power-word-shield.description: Until the end of its next turn the creature is immune to all damage except psychic, has advantage on saves, and other power word spells have no effect on it. It stops being poisoned and any fire on it is extinguished.

spell:primal-scent.description: Advantage on your next smell-based ability check, treating a d20 roll of 4 or lower as 5. Thereafter, smell-based checks treat 7 or lower as 8 at 5th level, 10 or lower as 11 at 11th, and 13 or lower as 14 at 17th.

spell:protection.components: V, S, M (a miniature silver shield worth 10 gp, which the spell consumes)
spell:protection.description: A ward circles a willing creature. Right before it next takes non-psychic damage, it gains resistance to all non-psychic damage (including that hit) until the end of its next turn, and the spell ends. One extra creature per slot level above 2nd.

spell:shackles-of-pain.components: V, S, M (a pair of manacles)
spell:shackles-of-pain.description: Link a willing source to a target that fails a Charisma save. Whenever the source takes damage, the target takes psychic damage equal to half and can repeat the save to end it. If you are the source, the target takes it before your concentration save.

spell:shielding-word.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature within range that you can see is hit by an attack from an attacker you can see or fails a Strength or Dexterity saving throw
spell:shielding-word.description: The creature gains 15 temporary hit points just before the triggering damage, lasting until the start of its next turn. Per slot level above 2nd, +30 feet range or +5 temporary hit points.

spell:smokescreen.description: Dense smoke heavily obscures a 5-foot-diameter, 10-foot-high cylinder on you until the start of your next turn, staying put or moving with you. Maximum size 15 feet at 5th level, 25 at 11th, 40 at 17th.

spell:spark.description: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 lightning, and a critical hit also blinds until the end of its next turn. Two sparks at 5th level, three at 11th, four at 17th, each a separate attack.

spell:spore-cloud.description: Each other creature within 5 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d4 poison, and failing by 5 or more poisons it until the end of its next turn. 2d4 at 5th level, 3d4 at 11th, 4d4 at 17th. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:stalker-s-eye.description: A willing creature's next attack has advantage, then the spell ends. That attack crits on 19 to 20 at 5th level, 18 to 20 at 11th, and 17 to 20 at 17th.

spell:sugar-rush.description: A willing creature gains +15 feet speed, +1 AC, and can Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object as a bonus action. When the spell ends, or if it doesn't move its walking speed on a turn, it is poisoned until the end of its next turn. One extra creature per slot level above 2nd. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:tentacle-lash.description: Your arm becomes a tentacle. When you cast it and as an action each turn, make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet: 5d8 bludgeoning, and a Huge or smaller target makes a Strength save or you knock it prone, shove it 5 feet, or take an item it holds. It also works as a grappling hook or rope. +1d8 per slot level above 4th. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:the-bends.description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save: 5d8 poison (d10s if fully submerged) and poisoned for 1 minute, or half. It repeats the save each turn to end the poison. +1d8 per slot level above 3rd. Biomancy school in the source.

spell:totem-arrows.components: V, S, M (a quiver containing at least one piece of ammunition)
spell:totem-arrows.description: Ammunition in a quiver carries a spirit (change it as a bonus action). Cat: +1d6 slashing, 2d6 with advantage. Elk: +1d6 bludgeoning and Strength save or prone or shoved 5 feet. Hawk: ignores half and three-quarters cover. Hogweed: Constitution save or blinded until the end of its next turn. Psilocybin: Wisdom save or tripping (d4 each turn, on 1 incapacitated and the effect ends). Roc: Strength save or speed 0 and lifted 20 feet until the end of its next turn. Snake: +1d6 poison and Constitution save or poisoned. Spider: Dexterity save or restrained until the end of its next turn. Concentration up to 8 hours at 5th level or higher.

spell:weavebend.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when you see a creature within range casting a spell
spell:weavebend.description: Redirect a spell of 3rd level or lower: retarget a ranged spell attack to a creature within 10 feet of the original target, or shift an area up to 10 feet. For 4th level or higher, succeed on a spellcasting ability check against DC 10 + its level. With a higher slot, spells below that slot's level are redirected automatically.

spell:weave-entanglement.components: V, S, M (a piece of felt)
spell:weave-entanglement.description: A creature casting a 1st-level or higher spell in a 20-foot-radius sphere makes a spellcasting ability check against your DC; on a failure its spell works but a d10 side effect also targets it: gravity smash, phantasmal killer, confusion, fireball, zippit!, web, darkness, silence, 2d10 healing, or no slot spent. Side effects need no concentration and end on a d20 of 11+ rolled at initiative 20 each round. +10 feet radius per slot level above 6th.

spell:armament.description: Up to five well-made nonmagical simple or martial weapons of your choice appear within range and vanish when the spell ends. Three more per slot level above 1st.

spell:at-your-side.description: You and up to three willing creatures form a bond: each gets +5 feet speed, and when one ends its turn, the others can use their reactions to move half their speed toward another bonded creature. One more creature per slot level above 2nd.

spell:beast-transmutation.description: A beast you can see becomes a humanoid commoner (Wisdom save if unwilling), keeping its mental scores, alignment, and personality. It uses the commoner's hit points and reverts at 0 with excess damage carrying over. +1 hour per slot level above 2nd.

spell:bubble-lift.description: A bubble lifts an object of up to 500 pounds 4 feet off the ground; it weighs 10 pounds, can be pushed with an action or by wind, falls 10 feet per round, and pops if pierced as an action. +500 pounds per slot level above 1st.

spell:butterfly-storm.description: Butterflies fill a 20-foot-radius sphere: heavily obscured, disperses fog, and difficult terrain. A creature trying to leave makes a Strength save or is pulled back to the space nearest the center. Creatures you choose ignore the effects.

spell:conjure-ocean.components: V, S, M (a piece of witch's eye coral)
spell:conjure-ocean.description: A 20-foot cube of deep-ocean water holds its shape within range; creatures can swim in and out. When the spell ends it crashes down, carrying creatures inside 30 feet in a random direction.

spell:control-animal.components: V, S, M (a bit of matted fur)
spell:control-animal.description: A beast of CR 2 or lower makes a Wisdom save or you take full control of it, using its senses and actions while your body is unconscious. When it takes damage, make a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check (DC 10 or half the damage) or the spell ends. +1 CR per slot level above 2nd.

spell:counterspy.components: V, S, M (a bag of sand and six candles)
spell:counterspy.description: A circle of candles and sand up to 10 feet in radius: if anyone outside it sees or hears you by any means, the flames change color, and if magic was used you learn the effect and its extent.

spell:create-spirit-train-stop.components: V, S, M (a blank ticket and high quality ink worth at least 50 gp, which the spell consumes)
spell:create-spirit-train-stop.description: Inscribe the code of a known permanent train stop and the Wandering Line arrives, carrying you and up to eight creatures there in 1 hour regardless of distance (with possible stops). Short rests aboard heal an extra 1d10 when Hit Dice are spent. You start knowing two codes.

spell:crustacean-form.components: V, S, M (a rust crab shell)
spell:crustacean-form.description: An ethereal crustacean shell gives you AC 20 (if higher), swim speed 40 feet, blindsight 30 feet, and a bonus action claw attack (spell attack, 1d10 bludgeoning). The shell has a damage threshold of 15.

spell:dara-blocks.components: V, S, M (a pinch of sand and a piece of pottery)
spell:dara-blocks.description: Five fixed, invisible 1-foot force cubes (visible to you and creatures you designate) appear within range, each holding up to 5,000 pounds; a Strength check against your DC moves one 10 feet. Two more per slot level above 3rd.

spell:divine-arrow.components: V, S, M (a pearl worth 100 gp)
spell:divine-arrow.description: Ranged spell attack: 4d10 force, and the target becomes vulnerable to acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, radiant, or thunder (your choice) for the duration; immunity becomes resistance and resistance is lost.

spell:duplicate.description: Create a functioning nonmagical replica of an object of up to 25 pounds you can see (Investigation against your DC to tell). 8 hours with 2nd- or 3rd-level slots, 24 hours with 4th or higher.

spell:ember-belly.components: S, M (a flask of oil, which the spell consumes)
spell:ember-belly.description: Once before the spell ends, exhale the swallowed oil as a bonus action in a 5-by-30-foot line: Dexterity save, 2d10 fire or half.

spell:festival-king.description: A creature becomes the Festival King. Creatures entering or starting their turn within 20 feet of it make a Charisma save (charm-immune succeed) or spend their action and bonus action adoring it; starting a turn outside the aura ends the effect for them.

spell:forest-guard.description: An immobile animated shrub makes a ranged leaf attack (your spell attack, 1d4 slashing) against hostile creatures that first come within 10 feet or start their turn there. A bonus action makes shrubs attack one creature within 10 feet, 1d4 per shrub. One more shrub per two slot levels above 1st.

spell:gift.description: You take 1d20 necrotic damage and a creature you can see within range regains that many hit points.

spell:jolt.description: Ranged spell attack: 1d8 lightning. Or power a working machine for 18 seconds as if whelmed by a spirit. 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 17th.

spell:light-snare.description: Ranged spell attack: on a hit the target is restrained and fixed in place until the end of its next turn.

spell:mass-levitate.components: V, S, M (a small leather loop)
spell:mass-levitate.description: Up to six creatures or objects of up to 500 pounds each rise up to 20 feet (Constitution save if unwilling) and can only move by pushing off surfaces. You adjust their altitude by 20 feet on your turn; they float down when it ends.

spell:monkey-s-grasp.description: An ethereal monkey paw tries to grapple a Huge or smaller creature on the ground (contest with your spellcasting modifier); a grappled target takes 1d8 necrotic at the start of each turn until it escapes. One more target per slot level above 2nd, within 60 feet of each other.

spell:mushroom-ballista.description: One to three pieces of ammunition sprout mushrooms: a hit deals +1d6 poison and the target makes a Dexterity save or is pushed back feet equal to the damage (rounded to 5, maximum 15). Recasting ends earlier ammunition.

spell:obscure-object.description: An unworn object no larger than a 5-foot cube becomes invisible.

spell:origami-bird-swarm.components: V, S, M (fine papers worth 10 gp, which the spell consumes)
spell:origami-bird-swarm.description: Eight paper birds hit a target within 30 feet for 8d6 slashing. A farther target is pursued at 30 feet per round; the swarm (AC your spell save DC) loses a bird per hit, and deals 1d6 slashing per remaining bird on arrival. Two more birds (or +2d6 close up) per slot level above 5th.

spell:pacify-monster.description: A creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or is pacified: it can't attack, cast spells affecting an enemy, or deal damage. It repeats the save at the end of each turn. One more creature per slot level above 4th, within 30 feet of each other.

spell:pacify-person.description: A humanoid you can see makes a Wisdom save or is pacified: it can't attack, cast spells affecting an enemy, or deal damage. It repeats the save at the end of each turn. One more humanoid per slot level above 1st, within 30 feet of each other.

spell:pillar-of-force.description: Ranged spell attack: 2d12 bludgeoning and a Huge or smaller target is pushed 10 feet; the ground between you becomes difficult terrain. +1d12 per slot level above 2nd.

spell:plummet.description: A flying creature makes a Dexterity save or is pulled to the ground and takes falling damage; on a success it drops halfway and takes no damage.

spell:pogmo-s-pot.description: A sealed, damage-immune 15-pound iron pot sucks in every unattended object of 10 pounds or less within 20 feet, releasing them when the spell ends.

spell:rageful-nimbus.components: V, S, M (a drop of water)
spell:rageful-nimbus.description: A cloud follows a creature; when a hostile creature you can see damages it, use your reaction for a ranged spell attack from the cloud against that creature within 60 feet: 2d8 lightning. +1d8 per two slot levels above 2nd.

spell:resilient-friendship.description: Give a creature the Help action's benefit; if it succeeds by the start of your next turn, you gain 1d4 temporary hit points for 1 hour (1d6 at 5th level, 1d8 at 11th, 1d10 at 17th).

spell:retrieve.description: An unattended object of 10 pounds or less flies to your open hand.

spell:root-grab.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature provokes an opportunity attack from you
spell:root-grab.description: Roots grasp the provoking creature, reducing its speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

spell:sand-structure.components: V, S, M (a small piece of seaglass)
spell:sand-structure.description: A 5-by-5-foot, 1-foot-thick wall of stone-hard sand rises (AC 13, 10 hit points); dismiss it as an action. Cast as a ritual, it lasts until destroyed or dismissed.

spell:spell-signature.description: A magical effect within range releases its creator's scent; you recognize a creature you know. Otherwise a spellcasting ability check (with proficiency) reveals its creature type (DC 5), class (DC 10), organization (DC 15), and name (DC 20).

spell:shared-vision.description: A familiar willing creature within a mile can see through your eyes with your special senses, swapping views as a bonus action, until it dismisses it as an action. One more creature per slot level above 2nd.

spell:sprout-foliage.description: Foliage covers you; while prone and motionless you pass for a bush (Investigation against your DC, Hide to re-disguise). As an action, hurl a pinecone or berry: ranged spell attack within 30 feet, 1d6 + spellcasting modifier bludgeoning.

spell:storm-stallion.components: V, S, M (the stem of a windbloom)
spell:storm-stallion.description: A wind stallion charges a 60-foot line, possibly carrying a Medium or smaller creature in its starting space (Dexterity save, may fail willingly). Creatures in its path make a Dexterity save, 6d8 bludgeoning or half. +1d8 per slot level above 4th.

spell:submerge.description: Link a body of water within range to one within 500 miles that you have seen or touched; creatures step in and out the other side for 5 feet of movement. If either is too small to submerge in, a 25 percent chance sends a creature to a random body of water.

spell:summon-jack-o-lantern.description: A giant jack-o'-lantern (AC 15, 100 hit points, 5,000 pounds) grows around up to four Medium or smaller creatures or one Large creature in a 5-foot radius (Dexterity save to leap out). Those inside see and attack with ranged or reach weapons only through its face; nothing passes through it.

spell:summon-vehicle.components: V, S, M (a small piece of rubber)
spell:summon-vehicle.description: A bicycle or small machine for one Medium or smaller rider appears within 5 feet, with a 60-foot speed usable with a free hand. Dismiss it as an action.

spell:swallow-magic.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when a spell cast by another creature fails to affect you
spell:swallow-magic.description: Swallow the leftover magic for one: regain 1d4 + spellcasting modifier hit points, +15 feet speed until the end of your next turn, or add 1d4 to one ability check before the end of your next turn.

spell:switched-form.description: Two humanoids you can see each look like the other, gear and all (within a foot of height). Physical inspection reveals it, and an Investigation check against your DC as an action sees through it. Dismiss as an action.

spell:tamh-gon-s-fiery-festival-feast.components: V, S, M (an uncommon ingredient, which the spell consumes)
spell:tamh-gon-s-fiery-festival-feast.description: Up to twelve creatures share an hour-long feast; afterward each removes one exhaustion level and for 24 hours gains +10 feet speed, +2 to Dexterity saves, and one use of Ember Belly.

spell:task.description: Magically complete a small harmless task you could do by hand (turn a page, butter bread, heat tea) on a target without total cover. Up to three at once; dismiss one as a bonus action.

spell:transparency.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when your location would be revealed to a creature while you are hidden or unseen
spell:transparency.description: You and your gear turn invisible and your steps are silent until the end of your next turn, or until you attack or cast a spell.

spell:vegetable-blade.components: V, S, M (a strip of grass)
spell:vegetable-blade.description: Fronds sprout; as a bonus action a creature pulls up a root-vegetable blade (proficient, finesse, 1d12 slashing). On later turns the wielder or an ally can take a bite as a bonus action to heal the damage die + your spellcasting modifier, shrinking the die a size each time until it is gone after a d4.

spell:water-bullet.description: Ranged spell attack: bludgeoning 5d6 within 10 feet, 4d6 within 60, 3d6 within 90. +1d6 per slot level above 1st.

spell:whelm-weapon.components: V, S, M (a drop of seawater)
spell:whelm-weapon.description: Up to three weapons you can see become water-wrapped; roll a d4, and their damage is reduced by that much (minimum 1) for the duration. Two more weapons per slot level above 1st.

spell:wind-sprint.description: Wind carries you to a creature you can see within range; your next melee weapon hit this turn deals an extra 2d6 slashing.

spell:ambush-prey.description: You become invisible with advantage on Stealth until you move 5 feet or more from where you cast it. Your first attack against an unaware target deals +1d6 and ends the spell. +1d6 per slot level above 2nd.

spell:elevated-sight.description: Project your sight to an invisible sensor up to 120 feet above you that moves with you (bonus action to adjust its height), giving a 360-degree aerial view. You are blind while using it but can switch views on your turn.

spell:feathered-reach.description: Your arms become wings: bonus action flight up to double your speed (landing afterward, no fall damage), once per turn propel yourself up half your speed, glide with your reaction when falling, and advantage on jump checks with triple jump distance and no run-up. Hands must be free of shields and heavy weapons.

spell:globe-of-twilight.components: V, S, M (a dab of pitch and a bag of glittering sand)
spell:globe-of-twilight.description: A lightly obscured starry sphere where only 3rd-level or higher magical light works normally. Creatures you designate can hide at any time with advantage on Stealth. Others have disadvantage on Perception inside and make a Wisdom save on entering or starting a turn there or are blinded until the end of their turn.

spell:gust-barrier.description: Until the end of your next turn, ranged attacks against you have disadvantage, and melee attackers that hit you make a Constitution save or are flung 10 feet and knocked prone.

spell:invoke-the-amaranthine.components: V, S, M (a holy symbol of the Amaranthines)
spell:invoke-the-amaranthine.description: Roll two d20s and assign each to attack rolls, skill checks, or saving throws. For 24 hours, use your reaction to replace a matching roll by a creature you can see within 60 feet with a recorded number before the outcome is known. Ends when both are used.

spell:shape-plants.description: Reshape plant life in a 5-foot cube for 1 hour, adjusting flowers, vines, thorns, or fruit; brambles can become difficult terrain dealing 2d4 piercing per 5 feet. A plant persuaded by speech may keep its form. +5 feet per slot level above 4th.

spell:spiny-shield.description: Until your next turn, melee hits against you deal 2d4 less damage and the attacker takes that much piercing; against ranged attacks you have +2 AC. +1d4 per slot level above 1st.

spell:stellar-bodies.description: Two stars orbit you, shedding dim light 10 feet; a creature within 5 feet that hits you in melee makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d8 radiant per star. Once per round as an action, hurl a star with a ranged spell attack within 120 feet: 4d8 radiant and a Constitution save or blinded until your next turn. One more star per two slot levels above 4th.

spell:veil-of-dusk.components: V, S, M (a pinch of soot)
spell:veil-of-dusk.description: A creature gains +1 AC and advantage on Stealth checks.

spell:mend-plants.components: V, S, M (a small twig and a loop of twine)
spell:mend-plants.description: Choose one: mend a break or tear up to 1 foot in a living plant; regrow foliage, sprout a seed, or revive a dead seed pod; make a 5-foot cube of plants flourish enough to conceal a Medium creature or become difficult terrain; or give a plant or plant creature 1d4 temporary hit points.

spell:freedom-of-the-waves.components: V, S, M (a strand of wet hair)
spell:freedom-of-the-waves.description: Seawater crashes through a 15-foot-radius, 10-foot-tall cylinder: Strength save or 2d8 bludgeoning and prone; up to your spellcasting modifier creatures automatically succeed. If you are in the area, you can vanish into the deluge and teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within it.

spell:freedom-of-the-winds.components: V, S, M (a scrap of sailcloth)
spell:freedom-of-the-winds.description: You gain a 60-foot flying speed and advantage on checks to avoid grapples and saves against being restrained or paralyzed. When targeted by a spell or attack, use your reaction to teleport up to 60 feet to a space you can see; if that takes you out of range you are unaffected, and the spell ends.

magic-item:adamantine-armor-legacy.description: This suit of armor is reinforced with adamantine, one of the hardest substances in existence. While you're wearing it, any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.

magic-item:air-elemental-gem.description: This blue sapphire contains a mote of elemental energy. When you use an action to break the gem, an air elemental is summoned as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell, and the gem's magic is lost.

magic-item:ammunition-1.description: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.

magic-item:ammunition-1-2-or-3-legacy.description: You have a bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. The bonus is determined by the rarity of the ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.

magic-item:ammunition-2.description: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.

magic-item:ammunition-3.description: You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.

magic-item:amulet-of-health-legacy.description: Your Constitution score is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitution is already 19 or higher

magic-item:amulet-of-proof-against-detec.description: While wearing this amulet, you are hidden from divination magic. You can't be targeted by such magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

magic-item:amulet-of-the-planes-legacy.description: While wearing this amulet, you can use an action to name a location that you are familiar with on another plane of existence. Then make a DC 15 Intelligence check. On a successful check, you cast the plane shift spell. On a failure, you and each creature and object within 15 feet of you travel to a random destination. Roll a d100. On a 1-60, you travel to a random location on the plane you named. On a 61-100, you travel to a randomly determined plane of existence.

magic-item:anchor-feather-token.description: This tiny object looks like a feather. You can use an action to touch the token to a boat or ship. For the next 24 hours, the vessel can't be moved by any means. Touching the token to the vessel again ends the effect. When the effect ends, the token disappears.

magic-item:animated-shield-legacy.description: While holding this shield, you can speak its command word as a bonus action to cause it to animate.
