magic-item:duplicitous-manuscript.description: Looks like a romance novel to others (action to change its look and plot). Spellbook holding hallucinatory terrain, major image, mirror image, mislead, Nystul's magic aura, phantasmal force and silent image; wizard focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for a illusion spell in it; reaction and 1 charge to give disadvantage on an Investigation check or save against your illusion spell.

magic-item:eldritch-claw-tattoo.description: Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. Unarmed strikes are magical with +1 to attack and damage. Once per dawn, bonus action for 1 minute: melee attacks reach 15 feet and deal +1d6 force.

magic-item:elemental-essence-shard.description: Attach to or detach from a Tiny object as an action; spellcasting focus. When you use Metamagic, its essence (d4) triggers: Air, fly 60 feet without provoking; Earth, resistance to a damage type until your next turn; Fire, a target catches fire and takes 2d10 fire at the start of its next turn; Water, chosen creatures within 10 feet take 2d6 cold and make a Str save or are pushed 10 feet and knocked prone.

magic-item:far-realm-shard.description: Attach to or detach from a Tiny object as an action; spellcasting focus. When you use Metamagic, a creature within 30 feet makes a Cha save against your spell DC or takes 3d6 psychic and is frightened until your next turn.

magic-item:feywild-shard.description: Attach to or detach from a Tiny object as an action; spellcasting focus. When you use Metamagic, you can roll on the Wild Magic Surge table (a resulting spell ignores Metamagic and concentration). Without the Wild Magic origin, once per dawn.

magic-item:fulminating-treatise.description: Spellbook holding contingency, fireball, gust of wind, Leomund's tiny hut, magic missile, thunderwave and wall of force; wizard focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for a evocation spell in it; reaction and 1 charge when your evocation spell damages a creature: +2d6 force and knock it prone if Large or smaller.

magic-item:ghost-step-tattoo.description: Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. 3 charges, regained at dawn. Bonus action, 1 charge: incorporeal until the end of your next turn, with resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing, immunity to grapple and restraint, and movement through creatures and objects (1d10 force if you end inside one).

magic-item:guardian-emblem.description: Holy symbol attached to armor or a shield as an action. 3 charges, regained at dawn: reaction and 1 charge to turn a critical hit on you or a creature within 30 feet into a normal hit.

magic-item:heart-weaver-s-primer.description: Spellbook holding antipathy/sympathy, charm person, dominate person, enthrall, hypnotic pattern, modify memory and suggestion; wizard focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for a enchantment spell in it; 1 charge when casting an enchantment spell to give one target disadvantage on its first save.

magic-item:illuminator-s-tattoo.description: Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. Write with your fingertip as an endless pen. Once per dawn, action: a page of writing becomes invisible to all but you and one named creature for 24 hours.

magic-item:libram-of-souls-and-flesh.description: Spellbook holding animate dead, circle of death, false life, finger of death, speak with dead, summon undead and vampiric touch; wizard focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for a necromancy spell in it; action and 1 charge to seem undead for 10 minutes (undead ignore you unless harmed; ends if you deal damage or force a save).

magic-item:lifewell-tattoo.description: Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. Resistance to necrotic. Once per dawn, when reduced to 0 HP you drop to 1 instead.

magic-item:luba-s-tarokka-of-souls.description: Random properties: 2 minor beneficial, 2 minor detrimental. Action, each once per dawn (save DC 18): comprehend languages, detect evil and good, detect magic, detect poison and disease, locate object, scrying. Concentration on divination spells always holds. Twist of Fate, twice per dawn: a creature within 15 feet has advantage (Weal) or disadvantage (Woe) on attacks, checks and saves for 1 hour; each use rolls d100 and on 1-14 frees a trapped undead soul that gets Weal while you and the target get Woe until it is destroyed. Attunement ends after 7 days without a Twist of Fate.

magic-item:lyre-of-building.description: Cast mending at will as an action. Reaction when an object or structure within 300 feet takes damage: it is immune to that damage type until your next turn. Action, each once per dawn: fabricate, move earth, passwall or summon construct.

magic-item:masquerade-tattoo.description: Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. Bonus action: change its color, pattern, size and place on your skin. Once per dawn, action: cast disguise self (DC 13).

magic-item:mighty-servant-of-leuk-o.description: A 10-foot black construct piloted by up to two attuned creatures (2-hour attunement inside, during which nearby targets risk a stray fist). Its hatch costs 10 feet of movement; the crew has total cover. Crew can move it and command its actions, or a Destructive Fist reaction for opportunity attacks. Huge construct, AC 22, HP 310. Leuk-o's ghost can act once per 24 hours unbidden, and below half HP the crew make a DC 20 Wis save or are charmed for 24 hours into a rampage. A secret 3-round code self-destructs it: DC 25 Dex save in a 100-foot radius, 25d6 each of force, lightning and thunder (half on success), and its parts land within 1,000 miles 2d6 days later.

magic-item:moon-sickle.description: Sickle giving +1 (uncommon), +2 (rare) or +3 (very rare) to its attack and damage and to druid and ranger spell attacks and save DCs; druid and ranger focus. Your healing spells restore an extra 1d4 while you hold it.

magic-item:nature-s-mantle-2014.description: Druid and ranger focus. In a lightly obscured area, you can Hide as a bonus action even while observed.

magic-item:outer-essence-shard.description: Attach to or detach from a Tiny object as an action; spellcasting focus. When you use Metamagic, its essence (d4) triggers: Lawful, end charmed, blinded, deafened, frightened, poisoned or stunned on you or a creature within 30 feet; Chaotic, a damaged target has disadvantage on attacks and checks until your next turn; Good, you or a creature within 30 feet gains 3d6 temporary HP; Evil, a damaged target takes +3d6 necrotic.

magic-item:planecaller-s-codex.description: Spellbook holding banishment, find familiar, gate, magic circle, planar binding and summon elemental; wizard focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for a conjuration spell in it; 1 charge when a conjuration spell summons or creates one creature to give it advantage on attacks for 1 minute.

magic-item:prosthetic-limb-2014.description: Replaces a lost limb and works like it; attach or detach as an action, can't be removed against your will, detaches when you die.

magic-item:protective-verses.description: Iron-locked (DC 20); action to arcane-lock it. Spellbook holding arcane lock, dispel magic, globe of invulnerability, glyph of warding, Mordenkainen's private sanctum, protection from evil and good and symbol; wizard focus. 3 charges, 1d3 at dawn: 1 minute and 1 charge to swap a prepared wizard spell for a abjuration spell in it; 1 charge when casting an abjuration spell to give a creature within 30 feet 2d10 temporary HP.

magic-item:reveler-s-concertina.description: +2 to your bard spell save DCs. Once per dawn, action: cast Otto's irresistible dance from it.

magic-item:rhythm-maker-s-drum.description: +1 (uncommon), +2 (rare) or +3 (very rare) to bard spell attacks and save DCs. Once per dawn, action: regain one Bardic Inspiration use.

magic-item:shadowfell-brand-tattoo.description: Tattoo: attune by holding its needle to your skin, which becomes the tattoo; it vanishes and the needle returns if attunement ends. Darkvision 60 feet and advantage on Stealth. Once per sunset, reaction when you take damage: halve it.

magic-item:shadowfell-shard.description: Attach to or detach from a Tiny object as an action; spellcasting focus. When you use Metamagic, curse one target of the spell: disadvantage on checks and saves with one chosen ability until the end of your next turn.

magic-item:spellwrought-tattoo.description: Holds one spell of up to 5th level; applying it with its needle lets you cast that spell once with no material components, then it fades. Cantrip and 1st: common, +3 ability, DC 13, +5 attack; 2nd: uncommon, same; 3rd: uncommon, +4, DC 15, +7; 4th: rare, same; 5th: rare, +5, DC 17, +9.

magic-item:teeth-of-dahlver-nar.description: A pouch of 20 story teeth. Action: draw one (d20; used teeth fall to the next lowest unused) and either sow it to summon its tale's creatures as allies for 10 minutes, or implant it to replace one of your teeth for a lasting power and drawback (up to 1 + Con mod implanted, min 2). If you do neither, at the end of the turn it either summons them as hostile or implants itself. Effects range from revivify charges and telepathy to fire breath, dominate monster and divine intervention. Each tooth is destroyed only by sowing it where its tale began.

magic-item:baleful-talon.description: +1 dagger. On a hit with a roll of 19 or 20, the target makes a DC 15 Con save, taking 6d6 necrotic (half on a success); a creature reduced to 0 HP by it turns to dust.

magic-item:breastplate-of-balance.description: 4 charges, regains 1d4 at dawn. Equalize: reaction and 1 charge when you or a creature you see within 60 ft. is about to roll a d20 with advantage or disadvantage; the roll is made straight. Expunge Imbalance: bonus action and 2 charges to cast lesser restoration.

magic-item:crown-of-whirling-comets.description: 6 charges, regains 1d6 at dawn. Star Flight: bonus action, 1 charge, fly speed equal to walking (hover) for 10 minutes. Starlight Strike: action, any number of charges, one bolt per charge that automatically hits creatures you see within 120 ft. for 2d4 cold each. Whirling Hail: action, 3 charges, ice storm (save DC 16).

magic-item:donjon-s-sundering-sphere.description: On attuning, attach it to a nonmagical melee weapon, which becomes +1 until attunement ends. While wielding it: advantage on saves against being sent to an extradimensional space, demiplane or other plane; once per dawn on a hit, the target makes a DC 16 Cha save or is banished to a harmless demiplane until the end of its next turn.

magic-item:euryale-s-aegis.description: While wielding: resistance to poison and immunity to petrified. Once per dawn, bonus action: a creature you see within 30 ft. makes a DC 20 Con save or is restrained, repeating the save at the start of its next turn (failure: petrified for 24 hours; success: ends). Action: cast lesser restoration, locate creature or transport via plants, each once per dawn.

magic-item:fabulist-gem.description: Once per dawn, action: create up to 100 gp of coins within 10 ft. that vanish after 1 hour. Bonus action: change the apparent style, color and quality of your clothing and armor (fails physical inspection).

magic-item:fool-s-blade.description: +2 weapon. Once per dawn, bonus action: feint against a creature within 5 ft., gaining advantage on attacks against it until your next turn. Once per dawn, reaction when a creature within 60 ft. attacks you: it makes a DC 15 Int save or the attack targets another creature of your choice in its reach.

magic-item:glimmering-moonbow.description: +1 bow; ranged hits deal an extra 1d6 radiant. Unloaded, it creates a vanishing magic arrow for each shot. Once per dawn, bonus action: become semi-incorporeal until your next turn, with resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing.

magic-item:jester-s-mask.attunementNote: by a bard, sorcerer, or warlock
magic-item:jester-s-mask.description: Spellcasting focus; +3 to Charisma-based spell attack rolls and save DCs. Once per dawn, reaction when hit by an attack roll: take no damage and teleport up to 30 ft. Once per dawn, treat a natural 1 on a d20 as a 20.

magic-item:plate-of-knight-s-fellowship.description: Once per dawn, bonus action: summon a spirit using the knight stat block within 30 ft. for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 HP. It acts right after you, obeys your commands (no action), and Dodges if not commanded.

magic-item:ring-of-puzzler-s-wit.description: 3 charges, regains 1d4 - 1 at dawn. Spend 1 charge to gain advantage on an Intelligence check.

magic-item:rod-of-hellish-flames.description: Arcane focus. Resistance to fire and necrotic. Once per dawn, cast hellish rebuke at 4th level (save DC 16). Once per dawn, when you cast a spell that deals fire or necrotic damage, deal maximum damage instead of rolling.

magic-item:rogue-s-mantle.description: Darkvision 60 ft. (or +60 ft. if you have it). Bonus action in dim light or darkness: teleport up to 30 ft. to dim light or darkness you can see, then have advantage on your first melee attack this turn. Once per dawn, cast antagonize (save DC 15).

magic-item:ruinous-flail.description: +1 flail; double damage to objects and structures. Once per dawn on a hit, the target makes a DC 15 Con save or is poisoned for 1 minute, taking 2d4 necrotic at the start of each of its turns (repeat the save each turn end).

magic-item:sage-s-signet.description: Action: cast augury once per dawn. Each signet also casts two spells once per dawn each, using your Intelligence: Bear (very rare) enlarge/reduce, polymorph; Hart (very rare) aura of vitality, mass cure wounds; Lion (very rare) destructive wave, fireball; Serpent (rare) fear, hex; Songbird (rare) charm person, hypnotic pattern; Wolf (very rare) freedom of movement, pass without trace.

magic-item:skull-helm.description: Resistance to cold, poison and necrotic. Once per dawn, cast spirit of death without material components.

magic-item:spindle-of-fate.description: 6 charges, regains 1d6 at dawn. Battle Foreknowledge: 1 charge when you roll initiative to add or subtract your proficiency bonus. Doom Foretold: action, 2 charges, a creature within 30 ft. for 1 hour: you sense its direction and movement on the same plane, and once per turn add 1d6 to damage you deal it. Twist of Fate: reaction, 3 charges, when a creature within 60 ft. makes a save or attack roll, flip the result (failure to success, miss to hit, or the reverse).

magic-item:starshot-crossbow.description: Ignores loading; unloaded, it creates a vanishing magic bolt for each shot. 3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn; bonus action and 1 charge to invoke a constellation: Balance (your next ranged hit before the end of your next turn lets you or a creature within 30 ft. regain 1d8 + proficiency bonus HP), Flames (until the end of your next turn, ranged hits deal an extra 2d8 fire), or Rogue (you and your gear are invisible until the end of your next turn).

magic-item:sun-staff.attunementNote: by a cleric, druid, or wizard
magic-item:sun-staff.description: +1 quarterstaff; hits deal an extra 1d8 fire. Spellcasting focus; once per dawn, when you cast a slot spell dealing fire or radiant damage, reroll up to your proficiency bonus in damage dice and use the new rolls. Bonus action: glow with sunlight, bright 15 ft. and dim 15 ft. beyond, until you douse it.

magic-item:voidwalker-armor.description: Once per dawn, bonus action: an invulnerable, condition-immune projection of you appears within 30 ft. until the end of your turn; you can attack and cast non-self spells from its space. Cursed: you won't part with it, removing it doesn't end the curse, and after each long rest you make a DC 11 Cha save or your soul is trapped in an object on another plane (your body inert and ageless) until the object is destroyed or wish restores you.

magic-item:warrior-s-passkey.description: Action in key form: cast knock. Bonus action: become a +1 longsword you are proficient with, dealing 1d10 force on a hit, until it leaves your grasp or you revert it as a bonus action. Ending attunement reverts it.

magic-item:weapon-of-throne-s-command.description: +1 weapon; grants proficiency in Intimidation and Persuasion. 5 charges, regains 1d4 at dawn; bonus action to cast (save DC 16) command (1), zone of truth (2), compulsion (4), banishment (4) or dominate person (5).

magic-item:card-sharp-s-deck.description: Action: throw a spectral card as a ranged spell attack using Dex, range 120 ft., 1d8 force. Once per dawn, action: cast spray of cards at 3rd level (save DC 15).

magic-item:deck-of-dimensions.description: 6 charges, regains 1d6 at dawn. Marked Card: bonus action, 1 charge, place a card within 5 ft.; once within 24 hours, action to teleport to it (it returns to the deck after use or 8 hours). Riffling Portal: action, 3 charges, cast arcane gate (the deck returns when the spell ends). Shuffling Stride: bonus action, 1 charge, throw a card up to 60 ft. and teleport to it.

magic-item:deck-of-miscellany.description: 32 cards, each depicting mundane gear (rations, tools, rope, weapons, coins and the like, plus a see-through window for a wall up to 5 ft. thick). Action: draw the card you choose and throw it within 5 ft.; it permanently becomes the pictured item or items.

magic-item:deck-of-wild-cards.description: Action: draw a random card and throw it as a ranged spell attack using Dex, range 30 ft., 1d4 slashing plus a suit effect (DC 15): Rods, target and creatures within 5 ft. make a Dex save or take 2d8 fire; Coins, target makes a Dex save or is blinded until the end of your next turn and creatures within 10 ft. of it take 1d6 lightning; Cups, target takes 1d10 cold and makes a Con save or is restrained until the end of your next turn; Swords, target and creatures within 5 ft. take 1d6 force and make a Str save or fall prone. The card returns.

magic-item:deck-of-many-more-things.description: 44 extra cards in the style of the Deck of Many Things, often combined with it into a 66-card deck. Declare a number of draws first and make each within an hour of the last; unmade draws all take effect at once. Most cards return to the deck after taking effect. Effects range from boons (ability score increases, languages, telepathy, a loyal wyrmling, gate or true resurrection castings, treasure, a bound deity's aid) to dangers (dropping to 0 HP, exhaustion, petrification, imprisonment in force chains, a hostile monstrosity or gelatinous cube, transformation into a beast, a vengeful revenant). About a third are harmful.

magic-item:deck-of-wonder.description: A 13-card deck (or 22 cards, 25% of the time) of minor boons and banes. Declare draws first, each within an hour of the last. Cards include temporary HP, +1 to weapon attacks or saves, resistances for 1d12 days, darkvision 300 ft., spell uses (augury, friends, knock), treasure, an uncommon magic weapon or wondrous item, and drawbacks such as initiative disadvantage, a 1d4 penalty to saves, reduced HP maximum, a stolen item, or a brief trip to an extradimensional space.

magic-item:deck-of-oracles.description: After a long rest, spend 10 minutes to roll and record a d20. Once in the next 8 hours, reaction right after a creature within 60 ft. makes a check, attack roll or save: it uses your recorded number instead. Once per dawn, cast divination from the deck.

magic-item:fate-cutter-shears.description: Magic dagger; hits deal an extra 1d6 force. Once per dawn on a hit: until the target finishes a long rest, attacks against it are critical hits on 19 or 20.

magic-item:fate-dealer-s-deck.description: Rare +1, very rare +2, legendary +3. Spellcasting focus that adds its bonus to spell attack rolls and save DCs. Action: expend and roll a Hit Die, add the bonus, and a creature you see within 30 ft. takes that much radiant damage or regains that many HP (your choice).

magic-item:house-of-cards.description: Once per dawn, action: the deck forms a shelter of your design within a 40-ft. cube centered within 30 ft., with one door and up to four windows only you can open, floor, roof and comfortable temperature. It has AC 15, 50 HP and immunity to poison and psychic, and lasts 24 hours, until dismissed as an action, or until destroyed.

magic-item:antimagic-armor.description: Once per dawn, reaction: advantage on a save against a spell. Once per dawn, cast antimagic field without components.

magic-item:armor-of-fungal-spores.description: Once per dawn, bonus action: spores fill a 10-ft. sphere around you; creatures there make a DC 15 Con save or are poisoned until the end of your next turn.

magic-item:armor-of-the-fallen.description: Cast speak with dead or animate dead, one of them once per dawn. If you die while attuned, the armor is destroyed.

magic-item:armor-of-weightlessness.description: 5 charges, regains 1d4 + 1 at dawn. Bonus action: cast jump (1 charge) or levitate (2 charges) on yourself.

magic-item:bloodrage-greataxe.description: +2 to attack and damage rolls while you are at half HP or less.

magic-item:bloodseeker-ammunition.description: Ranged attack rolls with it have advantage against a creature missing any HP.

magic-item:boomerang-shield.description: Ranged weapon attack with the shield (20/60 ft., Str or Dex, proficient if proficient with shields), 1d6 slashing; it returns to your hand after the attack.

magic-item:bow-of-conflagration.description: Hits deal an extra 1d6 fire; a flammable nonmagical object hit catches fire, taking 1d6 fire at the start of each of your turns until someone uses an action to put it out.

magic-item:bow-of-melodies.description: Before a ranged attack, play one melody: Precision (+1 to the roll if proficient in Performance, +2 with expertise) or Reverberation (on a hit, extra thunder damage equal to your Cha modifier).

magic-item:clockwork-armor.description: 4 charges, regains 1d4 at dawn. Spend 1 charge to turn a d20 you roll into a 10.

magic-item:dried-leech.description: On a ranged hit, the leech latches on and deals 1d4 piercing at the start of each of the target's turns until it has dealt 10 damage, the target dies, or a creature uses an action to remove it; then it dies and loses its magic.

magic-item:feywrought-armor.description: Advantage on saves to avoid or end being charmed. 3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn; action and 1 charge to cast compulsion (save DC 15).

magic-item:forcebreaker-weapon.description: +2 weapon. Striking a Large or smaller structure of magical force (forcecage, wall of force) shatters it; against a Huge or larger one it shatters a 20-ft. cube.

magic-item:gloomwrought-armor.description: Advantage on saves to avoid or end being frightened. 3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn; spend 1 charge to cast calm emotions (save DC 15).

magic-item:grasping-whip.description: +1 whip. On hitting a Large or smaller creature or object, you can pull it 5 ft. toward you instead of dealing damage.

magic-item:hammer-of-runic-focus.description: 3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn. Bonus action and 1 charge: a 15-ft.-radius rune circle at the impact point for 1 minute (or until replaced or dismissed as a bonus action); while inside it, +3 to attack and damage rolls with the hammer.

magic-item:shield-of-the-tortoise.description: +1 AC on top of the shield's normal bonus. Cursed until remove curse or similar: you can't discard it, your speed is halved, and your initiative d20 always counts as a 1 and can't be changed.

magic-item:sling-of-giant-felling.description: A Giant hit by a ranged attack with it makes a DC 18 Con save or falls prone.

magic-item:stonemaker-war-pick.description: +1 war pick. Once per dawn, cast meld into stone. 1d6 + 1 charges (not regained): on a critical hit against a creature under 100 HP, spend 1 to force a DC 15 Con save or it is petrified for 8 hours.

magic-item:sword-of-the-planes.description: +3 sword. Once per dawn, action: slice a rift up to 10 by 10 ft. within 5 ft. to another plane for 1 minute, opening at or near a destination you name (DM's discretion); anything entering it arrives on that plane.

magic-item:tidecaller-trident.description: +2 trident; advantage on attacks with it underwater. 3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn: control water (1 charge) or tsunami (3 charges), save DC 15.

magic-item:winged-ammunition.description: Ranged attacks with it ignore half and three-quarters cover, and long range doesn't impose disadvantage.

magic-item:wraps-of-unarmed-prowess.description: Uncommon +1, rare +2, very rare +3. Your unarmed strikes count as magical against resistance and immunity and gain the bonus to attack and damage rolls.

magic-item:telescopic-transporter.description: After 1 hour calibrating, make a DC 17 Arcana check to teleport you and up to eight willing creatures touching it to the celestial body it points at. On a failure, a mishap (d6): adrift in the Astral Sea, a different plane, the telescope explodes (8d6 necrotic within 60 ft., surviving Humanoids reincarnated), an Astral creature appears, a different body in the nearest Wildspace system, or arrival coated in harmless slime.

magic-item:blasted-goggles.description: 3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn. Action and 1 charge: a creature you see within 120 ft. makes a DC 15 Dex save or takes 3d6 fire. Cursed until remove curse: you can't remove them, and if a target rolls a 20 on the save you are blinded for 24 hours.

magic-item:shrieking-greaves.description: 3 charges, regains 1d3 at dawn. Bonus action and 1 charge: +30 ft. walking speed and advantage on Dex saves for 1 minute. Cursed until remove curse: you can't remove them, you have disadvantage on saves against being frightened, and starting a turn frightened makes them scream; you and creatures within 10 ft. make a DC 15 Con save, 9 (2d8) thunder, half on a success.

magic-item:arcane-propulsion-arm.attunementNote: by a creature missing a hand or an arm
magic-item:arcane-propulsion-arm.description: Attaches as a prosthetic that works as a normal limb and can't be removed against your will. It is a magic melee weapon you're proficient with: 1d8 force, thrown (20/60), flying back and reattaching after a throw.

magic-item:armblade.description: Attaches to your forearm while attuned; bonus action to extend or retract it. Extended, you wield it as if held but can't use that hand otherwise.

magic-item:belashyrra-s-beholder-crown.description: Darkvision 120 ft. that sees through magical darkness. 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 3 at dawn), action to cast (save DC 16): charm person (1), sleep (1), hold person (2), ray of enfeeblement (2), fear (3), slow (3), telekinesis (5), disintegrate (6), flesh to stone (6), finger of death (7). Symbiotic: can't be removed or unattuned except by a spell that ends a curse. Belashyrra can see through it.

magic-item:cleansing-stone.description: Action while touching it: removes dirt and grime from you and your clothes.

magic-item:docent.description: Sentient sphere embedded in your body (Int 16, Wis 14, Cha 14, telepathic). Stabilizes you with a +6 Medicine check when you end your turn at 0 HP. Knows Common, Giant and 1d4 more languages (learns more up to six), has +7 in Arcana, History, Investigation or Nature (d4), and casts detect evil and good or detect magic at will (d6).

magic-item:dyrrn-s-tentacle-whip.description: +2 to attack and damage, disadvantage on attacks against aberrations, +1d6 psychic on a hit, and a natural 20 stuns the target until the end of its next turn. Bonus action to retract into or draw from your arm. Symbiotic: can't be removed or unattuned except by a spell that ends a curse.

magic-item:earworm.description: You speak, read and write Deep Speech. 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn): detect thoughts (2) or dissonant whispers (1), save DC 15; detect thoughts reports to the nearest daelkyr. Symbiotic: can't be removed or unattuned except by a spell that ends a curse.

magic-item:everbright-lantern.description: Bullseye lantern lit like continual flame: 120-foot cone, bright for the first 60 feet and dim for the rest.

magic-item:finder-s-goggles.attunementNote: by a creature with the Mark of Finding
magic-item:finder-s-goggles.description: Add 1d4 to Wisdom (Insight) checks. Once per dawn, action: Insight check (DC 13 + days since contact) on an object to learn the type of the last creature that touched it, then cast locate creature to find it.

magic-item:glamerweave.description: Common: bonus action to animate an illusory pattern in the cloth. Uncommon: the illusion can rise from the cloth, and once per dawn add 1d4 to a Performance or Persuasion check.

magic-item:imbued-wood-focus.description: Spellcasting focus; +1 to one damage roll of a spell cast through it that deals its wood's type: Fernian ash (fire), Irian rosewood (radiant), Kythrian manchineel (acid or poison), Lamannian oak (lightning or thunder), Mabaran ebony (necrotic), Risian pine (cold), Shavarran birch (force), Xorian wenge (psychic).

magic-item:keycharm.attunementNote: by a creature with the Mark of Warding
magic-item:keycharm.description: Tie up to three of your alarm, arcane lock or glyph of warding spells to it; its holder gets the alarm, bypasses the lock or avoids the glyph, and with your command word can end one tied spell as an action.

magic-item:kyrzin-s-ooze.description: Drunk to attune. Resistance to acid and poison and immunity to poisoned. Once per dawn each: become amorphous for 1 minute (squeeze through 1 inch), and exhale a 30-foot line 5 feet wide of acid (DC 15 Dex, 36 (8d8) acid, half on success). Symbiotic: can't be removed or unattuned except by a spell that ends a curse; if you die with it inside, your corpse becomes a black pudding.

magic-item:living-armor.description: +1 AC and resistance to necrotic, poison and psychic. After each long rest, feed it half your remaining Hit Dice (round up) or gain 1 exhaustion. Symbiotic: can't be removed or unattuned except by a spell that ends a curse.

magic-item:living-gloves.description: Choose proficiency with Sleight of Hand, thieves' tools, one artisan's tools or one instrument when attuning; double your proficiency bonus on checks with it. Symbiotic: can't be removed or unattuned except by a spell that ends a curse.

magic-item:orb-of-shielding.description: Spellcasting focus. Reaction while holding it: reduce damage of its material's type by 1d4: Fernian basalt (fire), Irian quartz (radiant), Kythrian skarn (acid and poison), Lamannian flint (lightning and thunder), Mabaran obsidian (necrotic), Risian shale (cold), Shavarran chert (force), Xorian marble (psychic).

magic-item:scribe-s-pen.attunementNote: by a creature with the Mark of Scribing
magic-item:scribe-s-pen.description: Writes on any surface, visibly or invisibly; Mark of Scribing bearers always see it and can reveal it with an action. Writing on a non-construct creature fades in 7 days.

magic-item:shiftweave.description: Holds up to five outfits; bonus action command word switches between them (clothing only, no magical properties copied).

magic-item:speaking-stone.description: A gnome with the Mark of Scribing can touch it and use an action to cast sending to another speaking stone whose location or symbols they know; creatures within 5 feet of the receiving stone hear the message.

magic-item:spellshard.description: Stores up to a 320-page book, optionally passphrase-locked. Action to open your mind to it; reading or writing then takes concentration and normal time. A wizard can use it as a spellbook.

magic-item:ventilating-lungs.description: Replace your lungs: breathe normally anywhere (even in a vacuum or antimagic field), advantage on saves against harmful gases, and once per dawn exhale gust of wind (save DC 15) as an action. Your lungs return if attunement ends.

magic-item:wand-sheath.description: Clamps to your arm and can't be removed while attuned. Insert a wand as an action; extend or retract it as a bonus action and use it with a free hand. Sheath and wand share one attunement slot.

magic-item:wheel-of-wind-and-water.description: Mounted on an elemental vessel's helm, lets a Mark of Storm bearer telepathically control its bound elemental; on a mundane ship, raises its speed by 5 mph.

magic-item:guild-keyrune.rarity: Uncommon, Rare, or Very Rare (by guild)
magic-item:guild-keyrune.attunementNote: by a member of the relevant guild
magic-item:guild-keyrune.description: Action: set it down within 5 feet and it becomes a creature friendly to you and your guild that obeys you (Dodging if uncommanded), reverting at the end of its duration, at 0 HP, or when you speak the command word again; it can't transform again for 36 hours. Azorius (rare): giant eagle, 1 hour, telepathy within 1 mile and you can use its senses as an action. Boros (rare): veteran, 8 hours. Dimir (very rare): intellect devourer, 24 hours, pursuing one mission. Golgari (very rare): giant scorpion (Int 4), 6 hours, telepathy within 60 feet. Gruul (rare): ceratok (rhinoceros), 1 hour. Izzet (rare): galvanice weird, 3 hours. Orzhov (rare): winged thrull, 2 hours. Rakdos (uncommon): cackler, 1 hour. Selesnya (rare): dire wolf (Int 6), 8 hours, telepathy within 1 mile. Simic (uncommon): category 1 krasis with Grabber and Stabilizing Legs, 5 hours.

magic-item:guild-signet.description: 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn); spend 1 to cast your guild's spell (save DC 13): Azorius ensnaring strike, Boros heroism, Dimir disguise self, Golgari entangle, Gruul compelled duel, Izzet chaos bolt, Orzhov command, Rakdos hellish rebuke, Selesnya charm person, Simic expeditious retreat.

magic-item:illusionist-s-bracers.description: When you cast a cantrip, you can cast it again as a bonus action that turn.

magic-item:mizzium-apparatus.attunementNote: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:mizzium-apparatus.description: Arcane focus. You can try to cast a class-list spell you don't know or haven't prepared, using a slot and its components: Intelligence (Arcana) check DC 10 + twice the slot level (DC 10 for cantrips, which simply fail). On a failure you cast a random spell of that slot level instead: 1st burning hands, chaos bolt, color spray, faerie fire, fog cloud, thunderwave; 2nd blur, gust of wind, heat metal, Melf's acid arrow, scorching ray, shatter; 3rd fear, feign death, fireball, gaseous form, sleet storm, stinking cloud; 4th confusion, conjure minor elementals, Evard's black tentacles, ice storm; 5th+ animate objects, cloudkill, cone of cold, flame strike.

magic-item:mizzium-armor.type: Armor (medium or heavy, but not hide)
magic-item:mizzium-armor.description: Critical hits against you become normal hits, and on a successful Str or Con save against a magical half-damage effect you take no damage.

magic-item:mizzium-mortar.description: 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn). Molten Spray (1 charge, action): 30-foot cone, DC 15 Dex save, 5d4 fire, half on success. Mizzium Bombard (3 charges, action): 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder within 60 feet, DC 15 Dex save, 5d8 fire, half on success.

magic-item:moodmark-paint.description: Applied in 1 minute; for 8 hours a creature that sees you and passes a DC 10 Insight check (advantage for dark elves) learns your current emotion and its main source.

magic-item:pariah-s-shield.description: +1 AC per two allies within 5 feet (max +3) on top of the shield. Reaction: take the damage dealt to a creature you can see within 5 feet instead, as force damage.

magic-item:peregrine-mask.description: Flying speed 60 feet and advantage on initiative rolls.

magic-item:pyroconverger.description: Action: 10-foot cone, DC 13 Dex save, 4d6 fire, half on success. Each use roll d10 plus uses since your last long rest; on 11+ it malfunctions, dealing 4d6 fire to you, unusable until a long rest.

magic-item:rakdos-riteknife.description: +1 to attack and damage. A creature it kills has its soul trapped (up to five; revival only by wish), each adding 1d4 necrotic to its hits. Bonus action: release souls to regain 1d10 HP each. With five souls, reaction after a damaging hit: release them all, and a target under 75 HP makes a DC 15 Con save or dies (once per long rest if it kills).

magic-item:skyblinder-staff.description: +1 to attack and damage, and +1 to spell attack rolls while held. Reaction when a flying creature within 30 feet attacks you: it has disadvantage and makes a DC 15 Con save or is blinded until the start of its next turn.

magic-item:spies-murmur.description: Telepathy with a known wearer of another spies' murmur within 1 mile. Bonus action: let that creature hear what you hear for 1 hour (ends as a bonus action or if you're incapacitated).

magic-item:sunforger.description: +2 to attack and damage. Action: hurl it up to 120 feet to explode in a 20-foot sphere, DC 15 Dex save, 6d6 fire, half on success; recall it to your hand with an action. Once per short or long rest; uncalled, it returns after 24 hours or when attunement ends.

magic-item:sword-of-the-paruns.description: +1 to attack and damage. Once per turn, right after you Attack with it, Dash or Dodge, a creature within 60 feet can use its reaction to make one weapon attack, move up to its speed, or Dodge, respectively.

magic-item:voyager-staff.description: +1 to attack and damage, and +1 to spell attack rolls while held. 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn; on the last charge roll d20, vanishing on a 1): banishment (4), blink (3), misty step (2), passwall (5), teleport (7).

magic-item:flying-chariot.description: Riders and the creatures pulling it gain +1 AC, and it flies if pulled by flying creatures. Chariot rules: mounting or dismounting costs 5 feet, riders have half cover, speed equals the slowest puller, and multiple pullers share initiative and actions.

magic-item:helm-of-the-gods.description: Senses the location of celestials and fiends within 30 feet not behind total cover. After a long rest, pray to a god to store its spell (save DC 13): Athreos protection from evil and good, Ephara sanctuary, Erebos inflict wounds, Heliod guiding bolt, Iroas heroism, Karametra goodberry, Keranos thunderous smite, Klothys entangle, Kruphix dissonant whispers, Mogis hellish rebuke, Nylea faerie fire, Pharika lesser restoration, Phenax charm person, Purphoros searing smite, Thassa identify. 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn), 1 per cast.

magic-item:molten-bronze-skin.description: Adheres to your skin, wearable under clothes and removable only by choice. Resistance to fire, and no disadvantage on Stealth checks.

magic-item:potion-of-aqueous-form.description: For 10 minutes (or until incapacitated or dead) you become a pool of water: swim 30 feet, move through liquids, occupy creatures' spaces, pass through Tiny openings, douse nonmagical flames, resistance to nonmagical damage, and advantage on Str, Dex and Con saves. You can't talk, attack, cast spells or use magic items; gear melds into you.

magic-item:pyxis-of-pandemonium.description: Touching it for 1 minute grants a short rest and bless until your next rest (once per long rest), but you make a DC 17 Wis save or are charmed for 1 hour and try to open it. Opened, roll d8 (save DC 17): berserk fury within 60 feet, harm on all within 30 feet, tsunami, flesh to stone within 30 feet, maze within 30 feet, 1d4 hostile shadow demons, insect plague, or Otto's irresistible dance within 30 feet. It then vanishes for 24 hours.

magic-item:siren-song-lyre.description: Action: cast animal friendship, charm person, enthrall or suggestion (save DC 13), each once per dawn.

magic-item:sling-bullets-of-althemone.description: A pouch of 1d4 + 4 bullets with +2 to attack and damage; a miss teleports back to the pouch, a hit spends the bullet. Each has one property (d4): Banishment (DC 15 Cha save or banished), Fulguration (+2d8 lightning, and others within 10 feet make a DC 15 Con save or take 1d8 thunder), Stunning (+1d10 force and stunned until the end of your next turn), Tracking (marked for 24 hours; you know its direction).

magic-item:two-birds-sling.description: +1 to attack and damage. On a hit, the shot can ricochet to make a ranged attack against a second target within 10 feet of the first.

magic-item:akmon-hammer-of-purphoros.description: +3 to attack and damage, +3d10 fire on a hit. Resistance to fire, immunity to exhaustion, proficiency and advantage with smith's tools. Once per dusk each, cast animate objects, fabricate, heat metal, magic weapon, mending or shatter (DC 18). Piety with Purphoros adds random beneficial properties (10+ minor, 25+ major, 50+ another major); non-worshipers get 2 minor detrimental properties.

magic-item:dekella-bident-of-thassa.description: +3 to attack and damage, +2d10 cold on a hit. Once per dusk each: whip up or calm the sea within 1 mile for 1 hour, cast dominate monster (DC 18) on swimming beasts or monstrosities, and cast true polymorph (DC 18) into a swimming creature. Piety with Thassa: 10+ water breathing and swim 60, 25+ minor, 50+ major property; non-worshipers get 1 minor and 1 major detrimental property.

magic-item:ephixis-bow-of-nylea.description: +3 to attack and damage, no disadvantage at long range, crits on 19-20. Four season arrows return each dusk (DC 18): Spring awakens a beast or plant for 8 hours, Summer summons a Nyxborn lynx (tiger) for 1 hour, Autumn casts wall of thorns, Winter casts ice storm. Piety with Nylea: 10+ minor, 25+ major property; non-worshipers get 1 major detrimental property.

magic-item:khrusor-spear-of-heliod.description: +3 to attack and damage, +2d8 radiant on a hit; sheds sunlight 30 feet bright and 30 dim. Once per dawn, reaction when damaged by a creature within 5 feet: attack it, blinding it on a hit. 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn, DC 18): guiding bolt (1), daylight (3), sunbeam (6). Piety with Heliod: 3+ 15 temporary HP each dawn, 10+ and 25+ minor, 50+ major property; non-worshipers get 2 major detrimental properties.

magic-item:mastix-whip-of-erebos.description: +3 to attack and damage, +2d8 necrotic on a hit and you heal half of it; once per dusk an attack can reach 300 feet. Once per dusk each, cast circle of death or dominate monster (undead only), DC 18. Piety with Erebos: 1+ a minor detrimental property, 25+ and 50+ a major beneficial property each; non-worshipers get 2 major detrimental properties.

magic-item:bottle-of-boundless-coffee.description: Always holds warm coffee (and nothing else); poured coffee vanishes. Each drink roll d20: on a 1 it gives no coffee for an hour.

magic-item:cuddly-strixhaven-mascot.description: Action: stick it to your arm, shoulder or leg for 1 hour. Once per long rest (if the save succeeds), give yourself advantage on a save to avoid or end frightened while carrying it.

magic-item:lorehold-primer.description: 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn): add 1d4 to a History or Religion check. Studying it at the end of a long rest lets you cast one chosen 1st-level cleric or wizard spell once without a slot before your next long rest (Int, Wis or Cha).

magic-item:prismari-primer.description: 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn): add 1d4 to an Acrobatics or Performance check. Studying it at the end of a long rest lets you cast one chosen 1st-level bard or sorcerer spell once without a slot before your next long rest (Int, Wis or Cha).

magic-item:quandrix-primer.description: 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn): add 1d4 to an Arcana or Nature check. Studying it at the end of a long rest lets you cast one chosen 1st-level druid or wizard spell once without a slot before your next long rest (Int, Wis or Cha).

magic-item:silverquill-primer.description: 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn): add 1d4 to an Intimidation or Persuasion check. Studying it at the end of a long rest lets you cast one chosen 1st-level bard or cleric spell once without a slot before your next long rest (Int, Wis or Cha).

magic-item:strixhaven-pennant.description: While waved, its college symbol glitters and it sheds bright light 10 feet and dim light 10 more.

magic-item:witherbloom-primer.description: 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn): add 1d4 to a Nature or Survival check. Studying it at the end of a long rest lets you cast one chosen 1st-level druid or wizard spell once without a slot before your next long rest (Int, Wis or Cha).

magic-item:fish-suit.description: A bulky full-body suit that takes 1 minute to don or doff. While worn you can breathe in an airless environment and are immune to harmful effects of surrounding gases, and you gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed underwater, or a flying speed equal to it in zero gravity.

magic-item:spelljamming-helm.description: An ornate chair that propels and steers a ship of 1 ton or more through space, air or water (if built for it). While attuned, seated and concentrating, you move the ship up to its speed (in space with no other 1-ton object within 1 mile, up to 100 million miles in 24 hours), steer it clumsily, and see and hear from any point aboard. Transfer Attunement: as an action, touch a willing spellcaster to pass your attunement to them.

magic-item:wildspace-orrery.description: Inside a Wildspace system, this portable device tracks every sun, planet, moon and comet in the system and projects a display of them above itself, with a pulsing white point marking the orrery's own location.

magic-item:dragonlance.description: +3 to attack and damage rolls. When you hit a Dragon with it, the Dragon takes an extra 3d6 force damage, and any Dragon of your choice you can see within 30 feet can immediately make a melee attack with its reaction.

magic-item:flying-citadel-helm.description: An ornate chair (AC 15, 18 HP, immune to poison and psychic) that drives the flying citadel it is installed in. While attuned, seated and concentrating, you move the citadel up to 80 feet per round (8 mph), steer it clumsily, and see and hear from its highest outside point; with no one concentrating it hangs motionless. Transfer Attunement: as an action or bonus action, touch a willing spellcaster to pass your attunement to them. Crash: if the helm is destroyed, the citadel crumbles and descends 30 feet per round; creatures on it or within 120 feet of where it lands make a DC 20 Dex save, 39 (6d12) bludgeoning, half on success.

magic-item:kagonesti-forest-shroud.description: A cloak of woven autumn leaves. While worn you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Once per dawn, as a bonus action, teleport with your gear to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet and gain advantage on your next attack roll before the end of the turn.

magic-item:mirror-of-reflected-pasts.description: A 3-foot elven mirror (25 lb.; AC 11, 10 HP, vulnerable to bludgeoning). Held upright, speak its command word as an action to make it hover in place (it can't be moved) until you speak the word again or your attunement ends; once deactivated it can't be reactivated until the next dawn. A non-Construct creature other than you that sees its reflection within 30 feet makes a DC 15 Wis save or is paralyzed, lost in idealized memories, until the mirror is deactivated or it can no longer see the mirror (repeat save each turn end). A creature that saves or is freed is immune for 24 hours.

magic-item:mimir.description: A 5-pound skull-shaped device etched with planar sigils. As a bonus action toss it into the air to float 1d3 feet from you (counts as worn; AC 22, 25 HP, immune to poison and psychic, resistant to all other damage); another creature can snatch it as an action with an unarmed strike against AC 22 or a DC 22 Dex (Acrobatics) check, and you can stow it as a bonus action. While it floats: once per dawn, cast legend lore from it as an action, the mimir speaking the lore aloud; and it answers questions from you or those you designate about the planes and the Outlands' gate-towns.

magic-item:portal-compass.description: Its needle points toward the last portal it passed through while both are on the same plane; if that portal no longer exists, the needle stays still until the compass passes through a new one.

magic-item:sensory-stone.description: Holds one recorded experience. As an action, you or a willing creature you choose touches it to relive the sensation harmlessly. Record Sensation: as a reaction, store a sensation of up to 6 seconds experienced by a creature within 30 feet, replacing any stored one. Siphon Sensation: as a bonus action, end the charmed or frightened condition on yourself, destroying the stone.

magic-item:adze-of-annam.description: Annam's world-shaping adze; resizes to its wielder as a greataxe. Random properties: 2 minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, 2 minor detrimental. +3 to attack and damage rolls, an extra 3d12 force on a hit, and double damage to objects and structures. Divine Mattock: once per dawn, as an action, cast move earth or fabricate.

magic-item:armor-of-safeguarding.description: Bears a citrine with the shield rune. While worn, your HP maximum increases by 10 + your level. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, cast beacon of hope lasting 1 minute without concentration.

magic-item:bigby-s-beneficent-bracelet.description: Bigby's jeweled bracelet. Random properties: 1 minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, 1 minor detrimental. Dexterous Fingers: cast mage hand at will. Force Sculpture: three times per dawn, 1 minute of focus creates a translucent force copy of a Large or smaller nonmagical object within 10 feet, immune to damage and dispelling (disintegrate destroys it), lasting 8 hours or until dismissed as an action. Helpful Hand: once per dawn, as an action, cast Bigby's hand at 9th level (+13 spell attack) without concentration.

magic-item:bloodshed-blade.description: Add your Constitution modifier (minimum +1) to its damage rolls. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, when you attack a creature with it (even after rolling), spend and roll one Hit Die and add it to the attack roll; on a hit, you can spend and roll any number of Hit Dice and add them to the damage.

magic-item:crown-of-the-wrath-bringer.description: An iron circlet bearing enemy runes. When you hit a creature with an attack while wearing it, you can spend and roll one Hit Die to deal that much extra psychic damage. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, cast fear (save DC 15) lasting 1 minute without concentration.

magic-item:delver-s-claws.description: A clawed glove bearing the mountain rune; it is a simple melee weapon (finesse, light) dealing 1d4 slashing. While attuned you have a burrowing speed equal to your walking speed and blindsight 15 feet. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, spend and roll Hit Dice up to your proficiency bonus and regain the total plus your Constitution modifier in HP.

magic-item:glowrune-pigment.description: 1d4 + 2 pots of luminous paint, one rune each. Spend 10 minutes to paint one rune on a creature for 8 hours (or until wiped off as an action; one rune at a time). Journey: difficult terrain costs no extra movement. Life: 10 temporary HP and advantage on death saves. Light: darkvision 30 feet, or +30 feet to existing darkvision. Mountain: can't be knocked prone; advantage on Str and Con saves. Shield: advantage on Dex saves against damaging effects.

magic-item:harp-of-gilded-plenty.description: A sentient golden harp of Iallanis (chaotic good; Int 13, Wis 15, Cha 20; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; speaks Common and Giant and telepathy with its wielder; pompous). To attune you must pass a DC 15 Cha (Performance) or DC 20 Cha (Persuasion) check, retrying the next dawn on a failure. Stalwart Song: treat a 9 or lower on a Charisma check's d20 as a 10. Feast of Plenty: after 10 minutes of playing, cast heroes' feast; usable again after 1d10 + 10 days. Soothing Melody: five times per dawn, as an action, cast calm emotions (save DC 19) lasting up to 1 hour with concentration.

magic-item:helm-of-perfect-potential.description: Annam's helm for Diancastra, holding a shard of the Elemental Chaos. Random properties: 2 minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, 1 minor detrimental. Master of Guile: advantage on Cha (Deception) and Wis (Insight) checks. Arrow of Elemental Havoc: as a bonus action, a creature you can see within 90 feet makes a DC 20 Dex save, taking 4d6 acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder (your choice), half on success. Spellcasting: 6 charges (regains 1d6 at dawn), save DC 20: elemental weapon (1), call lightning (2), wall of fire (3), conjure elemental (4), tsunami (5).

magic-item:lash-of-immolation.description: +1 to attack and damage rolls and an extra 1d6 fire on a hit; on a critical hit the target is restrained until the start of your next turn. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, when you hit with it, use your reaction to make the extra fire damage 2d6.

magic-item:longbow-of-the-healing-hearth.description: +3 to attack and damage rolls; with no ammunition loaded it makes its own vanishing magic arrow. 8 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn. Curative Arrow: once per turn when you Attack, spend 1 charge to replace an attack with an arrow that automatically hits a creature within 150 feet, which can spend and roll one Hit Die to regain that much HP plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1). Spellcasting (save DC 18): create food and water (1), warding bond (2), guardian of faith (3).

magic-item:lucent-destroyer.description: A triple-barreled bronze musket: +1 to attack and damage rolls, needs no ammunition, deals radiant damage, and lacks the loading property. Cast dancing lights from it at will. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, cast sunbeam (save DC 17).

magic-item:mistral-mantle.description: A fur cloak stitched with the frost rune. While worn you resist cold, and when you move within 5 feet of a creature it makes a DC 14 Dex save or takes 1d6 cold and falls prone (once per turn per creature). Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, cast sleet storm (save DC 14); its area isn't difficult terrain for you and you see through it normally.

magic-item:nimbus-coronet.description: A bronze circlet bearing the cloud rune. While worn you take no falling damage, and as a bonus action you can teleport with your gear up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, take a cloud form for 1 minute (until incapacitated or dismissed): fly speed 60 feet and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing.

magic-item:orb-of-skoraeus.description: An 8-pound crystal-veined stone orb. While holding it, it is a spellcasting focus and: Abundant Components, 3 charges (regained at dawn), each spent ignores up to 300 gp of a spell's costed material components; Astute Mind, +2 to Con saves to maintain concentration; Divine Sight, see normally in magical and nonmagical darkness to 120 feet.

magic-item:prehistoric-figurines-of-wond.description: Rough dinosaur statuettes. As an action, throw one to a point within 60 feet and speak its command word to turn it into a friendly creature that understands your languages and obeys you (defending itself if uncommanded), if there is room. It reverts at the end of its duration, at 0 HP, or when you touch it and repeat the word as an action, then needs time to recharge. Carnelian Triceratops (very rare): triceratops mount up to 6 hours, every 10 days. Jasper Tyrannosaurus Rex (legendary): tyrannosaurus rex up to 1 hour, every 14 days; whenever you command it, roll a d20, and on a 1 it turns hostile until reduced to 0 HP. Kyanite Pteranodon (rare): pteranodon up to 8 hours, a mount for Medium or smaller riders, every 7 days. Pyrite Plesiosaurus (uncommon): plesiosaurus mount up to 12 hours, every 4 days; while riding it, cast water breathing at will.

magic-item:reaper-s-scream.description: +2 to attack and damage rolls, and it deals necrotic instead of piercing. When you roll a 20 to attack a creature with it, gain 10 temporary HP; while you have any of them, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 10 necrotic. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as a bonus action, chosen creatures within 60 feet make a DC 15 Wis save or are stunned until the start of your next turn.

magic-item:ring-of-amity.description: A hematite ring bearing the friend rune. On attuning, and after any long rest, bond with a willing creature you touch (one ring bond per creature): whenever magic restores your HP, it also heals them. The bond ends if either of you changes planes, you bond anew, or you sever it as a bonus action. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, when your bonded creature within 60 feet hits with an attack roll, use your reaction to make it a critical hit.

magic-item:sanctum-amulet.description: A black opal pendant bearing the sacred rune. While worn you resist necrotic damage and can cast spare the dying as an action or bonus action. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, when a creature you can see within 60 feet is reduced to 0 HP by damage, use your reaction to leave it at 1 HP instead.

magic-item:shield-of-the-blazing-dreadno.description: Once per dawn, as a bonus action, activate it for 1 minute: you are immune to fire; as an action, end one disease or the blinded, charmed, deafened or poisoned condition on a creature you can see within 30 feet (yourself included); and once per turn when you Attack, replace one attack with a shield bash against a creature within 5 feet, which makes a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Str modifier) or takes 3d6 bludgeoning plus 3d6 fire and falls prone (half damage only on a success).

magic-item:staff-of-the-rooted-hills.description: Resizes to its wielder. A +1 quarterstaff; the first creature you hit with it each turn makes a DC 12 Str save or is restrained by spectral vines until the start of your next turn. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, cast hold person (save DC 12) or speak with plants.

magic-item:stonebreaker-s-breastplate.description: Granite armor no heavier than metal. While worn you resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage and can't be knocked prone. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, cast wall of stone (save DC 14) with advantage on saves to maintain concentration on it.

magic-item:thunderbuss.description: +1 to attack and damage rolls, needs no ammunition, deals thunder damage, and lacks the loading property. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as a bonus action, a ball of energy bursts in a 10-foot-radius sphere on a point within 30 feet: DC 14 Con save, 3d6 thunder and no reactions until the end of your next turn, or half damage only on a success.

magic-item:war-horn-of-valor.description: Blow it as a bonus action to end the frightened condition on yourself and gain advantage on saves against being frightened until the start of your next turn. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn when you blow it, you and chosen creatures within 30 feet gain +1 AC until the start of your next turn.

magic-item:wayfarer-s-boots.description: While worn, +10 feet walking speed and advantage on Wis (Survival) checks. Invoking the Runes: once per dawn, as a bonus action, cast expeditious retreat.

magic-item:wyrmreaver-gauntlets.description: While worn, your unarmed strikes deal an extra 1d6 force, and after each long rest you choose resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison until the next. Invoking the Runes: once per dawn, as a bonus action, spectral fists envelop them for 1 minute (until incapacitated): your unarmed strikes on your turn have 30-foot reach, and a creature you hit with an unarmed opportunity attack makes a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Str modifier) or falls prone.

magic-item:zephyr-armor.description: While worn you have advantage on Dex (Acrobatics) checks and Dex saves. Invoking the Rune: once per dawn, as an action, cast wind wall (save DC 15).

magic-item:amethyst-lodestone.description: While carrying it you have advantage on Strength saves. 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn, usable while holding it. Flight: as a bonus action, 1 charge gives a fly speed equal to your walking speed (hover) for 10 minutes. Gravitational Thrust: as an action, 1 charge forces a creature you can see within 60 feet to make a DC 18 Str save or be pushed up to 20 feet in a direction you choose. Reverse Gravity: as an action, 3 charges cast reverse gravity (save DC 18).

magic-item:crystal-blade.description: Hits deal an extra 1d8 radiant. 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: when you hit a creature, spend 1 charge to regain HP equal to that extra radiant damage. As a bonus action while holding it, it sheds bright light 30 feet (and dim 30 more), dim light 10 feet, or none.

magic-item:dragonhide-belt.description: While worn, your ki feature save DCs gain the belt's bonus. Once per dawn, as an action, regain ki points equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die.

magic-item:dragon-wing-bow.description: Infused with one dragon breath type (acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant or thunder); hits deal an extra 1d6 of that type. With no ammunition loaded, it creates a vanishing magic arrow when drawn.

magic-item:emerald-pen.description: Writes without ink. While holding it you can cast illusory script at will without material components.

magic-item:flail-of-tiamat.description: +3 to attack and damage rolls, and hits deal an extra 5d4 acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison (your choice). Once per dawn, as an action, its five heads breathe a 90-foot cone: DC 18 Dex save, 14d6 acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison (your choice), half on success.

magic-item:gold-canary-figurine-of-wondr.description: As an action, speak its command word and throw it within 60 feet to become a friendly creature that obeys you. Giant Canary form: a rideable giant canary for up to 8 hours, once per dawn. Gold Dragon form (only while you are at half HP or less, with a second command word): an adult gold dragon without legendary or lair actions for up to 1 hour, once per year. It reverts at the end of its duration, at 0 HP, or when you touch it and repeat the word as an action.

magic-item:platinum-scarf.description: As an action, pull a scale and speak a command word (three per dawn; an unused scale vanishes after 1 minute). Breath of Life: you or a creature you touch regains 10d4 HP. Platinum Shield: for 1 hour the scale is a +1 shield granting its wielder immunity to radiant damage. Radiant Hammer: for 1 hour the scale is a magic light hammer dealing 2d4 radiant, plus 2d4 radiant against chromatic dragons.

magic-item:potion-of-dragon-s-majesty.description: Liquid gold holding a dragon scale. Drinking it turns you into an adult dragon of that kind for 1 hour, using its statistics but keeping your languages, personality and memories; your gear melds in or drops (your choice). You can't use the dragon's Change Shape, legendary actions or lair actions.

magic-item:ruby-weave-gem.description: While holding it, it is a spellcasting focus. 3 charges (regained at dawn): each spent when casting ignores up to 500 gp of costed material components. After each long rest, choose a spell of a level you can cast from any class list; you know it and can cast it with your slots until your next long rest.

magic-item:sapphire-buckler.description: While wielding it you resist psychic and thunder damage, and when a creature within 5 feet damages you, you can use your reaction to deal 2d6 thunder to it. Once per dawn, as an action, it hums if any Aberrations are within 1 mile, and you learn their directions.

magic-item:topaz-annihilator.description: A musket powered by a topaz dragon scale: range 100/300, two-handed, 2d6 necrotic, no ammunition. A creature or object reduced to 0 HP by it turns to dust (restored only by true resurrection or wish). Once per dawn, as an action, cast disintegrate (save DC 18).

magic-item:dragon-s-wrath-weapon.description: A hoard item that takes the damage type of the dragon breath it steeped in. Slumbering (uncommon): on a 20 on the attack roll, chosen creatures within 5 feet of the target take 5 damage of that type. Stirring (rare): also +1 to attack and damage rolls and an extra 1d6 of that type on a hit. Wakened (very rare): +2 and 2d6, and once per dawn, as an action, a 30-foot cone, DC 16 Dex save, 8d6 of that type, half on success. Ascendant (legendary): +3 and 3d6, and the cone is 60 feet, DC 18, 12d6.

magic-item:dragon-touched-focus.description: A hoard item. Slumbering (uncommon): advantage on initiative rolls, and it is a spellcasting focus for all your spells. Stirring (rare): by dragon family, Chromatic adds 1d6 to one damage roll of a slotted spell dealing acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison; Gem lets you teleport 15 feet when you cast a slotted spell; Metallic lets you use your reaction to give a creature within 30 feet advantage on a save. Wakened (very rare): cast each family spell once per dawn: Chromatic hold monster and Rime's binding ice, Gem Rary's telepathic bond and Raulothim's psychic lance, Metallic Fizban's platinum shield and legend lore. Ascendant (legendary): once per dawn, cast a 1st-level or higher spell as if with a 9th-level slot.

magic-item:dragon-vessel.description: A hoard item. Once per dawn, as a bonus action, fill it while empty (potions lose magic after 24 hours). Slumbering (uncommon): ale, olive oil, potion of healing or potion of climbing. Stirring (rare): also mead, potion of fire breath or potion of greater healing. Wakened (very rare): also wine, potion of flying or potion of superior healing. Ascendant (legendary): also whiskey, potion of supreme healing or potion of dragon's majesty.

magic-item:scaled-ornament.description: A hoard item. Slumbering (uncommon): advantage on saves to avoid or end charmed and frightened. Stirring (rare): +1 AC, immunity to charmed and frightened, and chosen creatures within 30 feet gain advantage on saves to avoid or end those conditions. Wakened (very rare): also, once per dawn, when you would take damage of its dragon's breath type, use your reaction to take none and regain that many HP. Ascendant (legendary): also a fly speed equal to your walking speed (hover) on spectral wings.

magic-item:acheron-blade.description: +1 to attack and damage rolls; while it is on your person you are immune to effects that turn undead. Dark Blessing: once per dusk, as an action while holding it, gain 1d4 + 4 temporary HP. Disheartening Strike: once per dusk, when you hit a creature with it, that creature has disadvantage on its next save before the end of your next turn (unless immune to frightened).

magic-item:amulet-of-the-drunkard.description: Once per dawn while wearing it, regain 4d4 + 4 HP when you drink a pint of beer, ale, mead or wine.

magic-item:arcane-cannon.description: A Large cannon needing no ammunition or loading: one action to aim, one to fire, then 5 minutes to recharge. The firer picks: Acid Jet, 300-foot line, DC 15 Dex save, 4d10 acid, half on success, plus 2d10 acid each turn on a failure until washed off as an action; Fire Jet, 300-foot line, DC 15 Dex save, 6d10 fire, half on success, igniting unattended flammables; Frost Shot, 30-foot-radius sphere within 1,200 feet, DC 15 Con save, 4d10 cold and -10 feet speed for 1 minute (repeat save each turn end), half and no slow on a success; Lightning Shot, 20-foot-radius sphere within 1,200 feet, DC 15 Dex save (disadvantage in metal armor), 6d10 lightning, half on success; Poison Spray, 60-foot cone, DC 15 Con save, 4d10 poison and poisoned for 1 minute (repeat save each turn end), half and not poisoned on a success.

magic-item:battering-shield.description: An iron tower shield granting +1 AC beyond its normal bonus. 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: when you push a creature within reach at least 5 feet, spend 1 to push it 10 more feet, knock it prone, or both.

magic-item:bloodaxe.description: +2 to attack and damage rolls and an extra 1d6 necrotic against creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead; reducing such a creature to 0 HP with it grants you 10 temporary HP.

magic-item:breathing-bubble.description: Worn over the head like a helmet, it holds 1 hour of breathable air, refilling at dawn.

magic-item:brooch-of-living-essence.description: While worn, magic that detects your creature type reads you as Humanoid, and magic that reveals alignment reads you as neutral.

magic-item:butcher-s-bib.description: A perpetually bloody apron. While worn, once per turn you can reroll a melee weapon attack's damage dice (using the new total), and your slashing weapon attacks score critical hits on 19 or 20.

magic-item:coin-of-delving.description: A copper coin shedding dim light 5 feet. Dropped more than 5 feet, it chimes on landing, and anyone who hears it can tell how far it fell.

magic-item:corpse-slayer.description: +1 to attack and damage rolls. Hits against Undead deal an extra 1d8 of the weapon's type, and the target has disadvantage on saves against turn undead effects until the start of your next turn.

magic-item:dispelling-stone.description: Thrown up to 30 feet, it shatters in a 10-foot-radius burst that ends every spell of 5th level or lower in the area.

magic-item:duskcrusher.description: A leather-wrapped rod; as a bonus action a radiant warhammer head appears (an action dismisses it), shedding sunlight 15 feet bright and 15 dim. While active: +2 to attack and damage rolls, radiant damage instead of bludgeoning, an extra 1d8 radiant against Undead, and once per dawn, as an action, cast sunbeam (save DC 15).

magic-item:dust-of-deliciousness.description: Six servings of seasoning that make food delicious, but anyone who eats it has disadvantage on Wisdom checks and saves for 1 hour.

magic-item:goggles-of-object-reading.description: While worn, advantage on Int (Arcana) checks to learn about a creature or object you can see, and once per dawn you can cast identify with them.

magic-item:hunter-s-coat.description: +1 AC. 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: when you hit a creature that is missing any HP, spend 1 to deal an extra 1d10 necrotic.

magic-item:last-stand-armor.description: +1 AC. If you die while wearing it, it is destroyed, and each Celestial, Fey and Fiend within 30 feet makes a DC 15 Cha save or is banished to its home plane.

magic-item:luxon-beacon.description: A glowing crystal dodecahedron. Once per dawn, a creature that touches it and concentrates for 1 minute gains a Fragment of Possibility for 8 hours (one at a time from any source): spend it to roll an extra d20 on an attack roll, check or save, or when attacked, and choose which die to use (rolled after advantage or disadvantage). Soul Snare: a consecrated follower of the Luxon who dies within 100 miles has their soul drawn in and reincarnated in a developing humanoid baby within 100 miles.

magic-item:needle-of-mending.description: A sewing needle that becomes a +1 dagger (or back) when you speak its command word as a bonus action. While holding it, you can cast mending as an action.

magic-item:nightfall-pearl.description: A cold black orb. After 10 minutes of activation, everything within 10 miles becomes night for 24 hours, until you end it as an action or lose attunement; usable again after 24 hours.

magic-item:orb-of-the-veil.description: While on your person: +2 Wisdom (and maximum), darkvision 60 feet (or +60 feet), and advantage on Wisdom checks to find hidden doors and paths. Curse: you won't part with it, nonmagical flames within 30 feet go out, and your fire damage is halved.

magic-item:potion-of-maximum-power.description: The first damaging spell of 4th level or lower you cast within 1 minute of drinking it deals maximum damage on every die instead of rolling.

magic-item:potion-of-possibility.description: Grants two Fragments of Possibility lasting 8 hours each (no others while you have them): spend one to roll an extra d20 on an attack roll, check or save, or when attacked, and choose which die to use (rolled after advantage or disadvantage).

magic-item:reincarnation-dust.description: Sprinkled on a dead Humanoid's remains, it returns a willing soul to life in a new body as if by reincarnate.

magic-item:ring-of-obscuring.description: 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: as an action, spend 1 to cast fog cloud centered on yourself, lasting 1 minute without concentration.

magic-item:ring-of-temporal-salvation.description: If you die while wearing it, you reappear within 5 feet with 3d6 + your Constitution modifier HP (raising your HP maximum if needed) and one less level of exhaustion; the ring then turns to dust.

magic-item:rod-of-retribution.description: 3 charges, regained at dawn: when a creature you can see within 60 feet damages you while you hold it, use your reaction and 1 charge to force a DC 13 Dex save, 2d10 lightning, half on success.

magic-item:spell-bottle.description: Stores one spell of 1st to 5th level (found with a d6 - 1 level spell of the DM's choice, 0 meaning empty). Anyone can cast a spell into it while touching it; while holding it you can cast the stored spell using the original caster's slot level, DC, attack bonus and ability, emptying it. While empty, as a reaction when a creature within 60 feet casts a spell, you can trap a spell of 3rd level or lower, or one of higher level with a successful Int check (DC 10 + spell level).

magic-item:staff-of-dunamancy.description: 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn (spending the last: on a d20 roll of 1 it crumbles). As an action, cast with your DC and attack bonus: fortune's favor (2), pulse wave (3), gravity sinkhole (4). New Possibility: once per dawn while holding it, turn a failed save against a spell that targets only you into a success.

magic-item:staff-of-the-ivory-claw.description: While holding it, +1 to spell attack rolls, and critical hits with spell attacks deal an extra 3d6 radiant.

magic-item:vox-seeker.description: A plate-sized clockwork crab. Each action spent winding it runs it for 1 minute (up to 10); while running it is a DM-controlled vox seeker that hunts the nearest voice, and it is destroyed at 0 HP.

magic-item:weapon-of-certain-death.description: A creature damaged by an attack with it can't regain HP until the start of your next turn.

magic-item:danoth-s-visor.description: A Vestige of Divergence (dormant, awakened around level 9, exalted around level 16; benefits stack). Dormant: see normally in magical and nonmagical darkness to 60 feet, and advantage on sight-based Int (Investigation) and Wis (Perception) checks. Awakened: see invisible things and into the Ethereal Plane within 60 feet; once per dawn, as a bonus action, see through up to 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal or 3 feet of wood or dirt within 60 feet for 1 minute (lead blocks it); as a bonus action, toggle 2x magnification. Exalted: automatically detect and succeed on saves against illusions you can see, and see an aura around shapechanged creatures; once per dawn, as an action, cast antimagic field.

magic-item:grimoire-infinitus.description: A Vestige of Divergence: an endless, 3-pound spellbook. Dormant: it holds alarm, antimagic field, Bigby's hand, blight, charm person, confusion, control weather, create undead, detect thoughts, enlarge/reduce, fear, foresight, gaseous form, glyph of warding, legend lore, Leomund's tiny hut, mass suggestion, mislead, misty step, Mordenkainen's faithful hound, prismatic spray, ray of enfeeblement, silent image, teleport and thunderwave; used as your spellbook, you prepare one extra wizard spell. Awakened: advantage on saves against spells and magical effects while carrying it, and one more prepared spell. Exalted: Arcane Recovery twice between long rests, and one more prepared spell.

magic-item:hide-of-the-feral-guardian.description: A Vestige of Divergence. Dormant: +1 AC; while transformed by an effect that replaces your statistics you keep the armor's benefits and gain +1 to melee attack and damage rolls; once per dawn, as an action, polymorph yourself into a giant owl, keeping your Int, Wis and Cha. Awakened: +2 AC and +2 to those rolls, and the polymorph can make you a cave bear (polar bear statistics). Exalted: +3 AC and +3 to those rolls, and the polymorph can make you a guardian wolf.

magic-item:infiltrator-s-key.description: A Vestige of Divergence. Dormant: works as thieves' tools for locks with proficiency and advantage, and advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks to move silently while holding it. Awakened: as a bonus action it becomes a +1 dagger that returns after ranged attacks (or a key again); once per dawn each, as an action, cast alter self, invisibility, knock or pass without trace. Exalted: once per dawn, as a bonus action, open a passage up to 10 by 10 feet through a surface up to 5 feet thick, closing once the key passes through (shunting anyone inside safely); once per dawn each, cast dimension door, gaseous form or mislead.

magic-item:stormgirdle.description: A Vestige of Divergence of Kord. Dormant: resistance to lightning and thunder and Strength 21; once per dawn, as an action, become a Storm Avatar for 1 minute: immune to lightning and thunder, bludgeoning weapon hits deal thunder and piercing or slashing hits deal lightning, and as a bonus action a creature within 30 feet makes a DC 15 Dex save, 3d6 lightning, half on success. Awakened: Strength 23, the strike deals 4d6, and the avatar flies 30 feet (hover). Exalted: Strength 25, the strike deals 5d6, and once per dawn you can cast control weather.

magic-item:verminshroud.description: A Vestige of Divergence. Dormant: advantage on smell-based Wis (Perception) checks, immunity to disease, darkvision 60 feet (or +60); once per dawn, as an action, polymorph into a rat or giant rat keeping your Int, Wis, Cha and the cloak's benefits. Awakened: resistance to poison; once per dawn cast insect plague (save DC 15, no material components); the polymorph can make you a giant wasp. Exalted: climb speed equal to walking speed; a bite natural weapon (1d6 + Str piercing, usable as a bonus action) whose damage forces a DC 17 Con save or poisoned for 1 minute (repeat save each turn end); the polymorph can make you a giant scorpion.

magic-item:wreath-of-the-prism.description: A Vestige of Divergence: a crown of golden thorns set with Tiamat's five colors. Dormant: darkvision 60 feet (or +60); when you hit or grapple a Beast, Dragon or Monstrosity of CR 5 or lower, you can cast dominate monster on it (save DC 13); a success grants it 24-hour immunity, a failure marks it with a golden collar or crown while charmed, charming a second creature ends the first, and it knows you charmed it. Awakened: CR 10 or lower, DC 15. Exalted: CR 15 or lower, DC 17.

magic-item:blade-of-broken-mirrors.description: An Arm of the Betrayers holding the glabrezu Ragazuu (sentient chaotic evil; Int 21, Wis 24, Cha 24; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Abyssal and Common), who urges reckless revolution. Artifact properties: 1 minor beneficial and 1 minor detrimental when dormant, plus one of each when awakened and 1 major beneficial when exalted. Dormant: you know Abyssal; +1 dagger that returns after ranged attacks; it remembers Humanoids it kills (forgotten on a new attunement), and as an action you can take any remembered form (statistics unchanged except size), reverting as an action or on death.
